let spores = farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap, upgradeLevel(progress, farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap))
return caps * spores
}
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) {
return farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.Charge, upgradeLevel(progress, farmTypes.Upgrade.Charge))
}
return 0
}

function placementAt(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number, slotId: number): farmTypes.Placement {
if (!progress || !progress.placements) return null
for (let i = 0; i < progress.placements.length; i++) {
let placement = progress.placements[i]
if (placement && placement.area == area && placement.slot == slotId) return placement
}
return null
}

function placementCount(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number): number {
if (!progress || !progress.placements) return 0
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < progress.placements.length; i++) {
let placement = progress.placements[i]
if (placement && placement.area == area && validCrop(placement.crop) && slotById(placement.slot)) count += 1
}
return count
}

function placementCropCount(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number, crop: number): number {
if (!progress || !progress.placements || !validCrop(crop)) return 0
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < progress.placements.length; i++) {
let placement = progress.placements[i]
if (placement && placement.area == area && placement.crop == crop && slotById(placement.slot)) count += 1
}
return count
}

function defenderCapForArea(area: number): number {
if (area <= 1) return 0
if (area == 2) return 2
if (area == 3 || area == 4) return 3
if (area == 5 || area == 6 || area == 7) return 4
if (area == 8 || area == 9 || area == 10) return 5
if (area == 11 || area == 12) return 6
return 0
}

function requiredDefenderCrop(area: number): number {
if (area < 2 || area > 12) return 0
return area - 1
}

function isPrepPhase(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number): boolean {
if (!progress || !progress.phase || area < 0 || area >= progress.phase.length) return false
return progress.phase[area] == farmTypes.Phase.Prep
}

function powerEarned(progress: farmTypes.Progress, crop: number): boolean {
return validCrop(crop) && progressValue(progress ? progress.powerEarned : null, crop) != 0
}

function compatibleEnergyCompanionPresent(progress: farmTypes.Progress, area: number): boolean {
return placementCropCount(progress, area, farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) > 0 || placementCropCount(progress, area, farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) > 0
}

function clearDefenderSpritesOnly(): void {
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) destroyOwnedSprite(defenders[i].sprite)
defenders = []
defenderDestroyIds = []
}

function createDefenderFromPlacement(placement: farmTypes.Placement, progress: farmTypes.Progress): DefenderRuntime {
if (!placement || placement.area != currentArea || !validCrop(placement.crop)) return null
let slot = slotById(placement.slot)
if (!slot) return null

let defender = new DefenderRuntime()
defender.id = nextActorId++
defender.crop = placement.crop
defender.slot = placement.slot
defender.epoch = epoch
defender.maxHp = defenderMaxHp(placement.crop)
defender.hp = defender.maxHp
// Battle immobilization is transient. World roots durable placements only
// after victory; its pre-raid snapshot retains adjustable staged records.
defender.rooted = placement.rooted || raidWorldCommitted(progress, placement.area)
defender.wilted = false
defender.pendingDestroy = false
defender.resourceCap = defenderResourceCapacity(placement.crop, progress)
defender.resource = defender.resourceCap
defender.resourceMs = 0
defender.actionMs = 0
defender.engagedEnemyId = -1
defender.sporeLoaded = []
defender.sporeActive = false
defender.sporeNextIndex = 0
if (placement.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
for (let i = 0; i < defender.resourceCap; i++) defender.sporeLoaded.push(1)
}

// Art has rooted/attack/wilted states, not a separate staged sprite. The
// same healthy plant image is used while staged; rooted controls gameplay.
defender.sprite = sprites.create(farmArt.frame("crop." + cropArtStem(placement.crop) + ".rooted", 0), DefenderKind)
defender.sprite.setPosition(tileCenterX(slot.tile), tileCenterY(slot.tile))
return defender
}

function rebuildDefendersFromWorld(): void {
clearDefenderSpritesOnly()
if (!entered || !activeLayout) return
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!progress || !progress.placements) return
let usedSlots: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < progress.placements.length; i++) {
let placement = progress.placements[i]
if (!placement || placement.area != currentArea || !validCrop(placement.crop)) continue
if (!slotById(placement.slot) || containsNumber(usedSlots, placement.slot)) continue
let defender = createDefenderFromPlacement(placement, progress)
if (!defender) continue
defenders.push(defender)
usedSlots.push(placement.slot)
}
}

function availableDefenderCrops(progress: farmTypes.Progress): number[] {
let crops: number[] = []
if (!progress || !progress.inventory) return crops
for (let crop = MIN_CROP; crop <= MAX_CROP; crop++) {
if (progressValue(progress.inventory, crop) > 0) crops.push(crop)
}
return crops
}

function defenderOptionLabel(crop: number, count: number): string {
return cropDisplayName(crop) + " x" + count
}

function stageDefenderAtSlot(slotId: number): boolean {
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!isPrepPhase(progress, currentArea)) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender setup is only available before Ready.")
return true
}
if (placementAt(progress, currentArea, slotId)) return true
let cap = defenderCapForArea(currentArea)
if (cap <= 0) {
farmWorld.notice("This raid is player-only.")
return true
}
if (placementCount(progress, currentArea) >= cap) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender limit reached: " + cap)
return true
}

let crops = availableDefenderCrops(progress)
if (crops.length == 0) {
farmWorld.notice("NO DEFENDERS READY")
return true
}
let options: string[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < crops.length; i++) {
options.push(defenderOptionLabel(crops[i], progressValue(progress.inventory, crops[i])))
}

let openEpoch = epoch
let openArea = currentArea
let opened = farmWorld.choose("DEFENDER TRAY", options, function(choice: number) {
if (!entered || epoch != openEpoch || currentArea != openArea) return
if (choice < 0 || choice >= crops.length) return
let latest = farmWorld.progress()
if (!isPrepPhase(latest, openArea)) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender setup is closed.")
return
}
if (placementAt(latest, openArea, slotId)) {
farmWorld.notice("That defender slot is already occupied.")
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
return
}
let currentCap = defenderCapForArea(openArea)
if (placementCount(latest, openArea) >= currentCap) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender limit reached: " + currentCap)
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
return
}
let crop = crops[choice]
if (progressValue(latest.inventory, crop) <= 0) {
farmWorld.notice("That defender is no longer available.")
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
return
}
let placement = new farmTypes.Placement()
placement.area = openArea
placement.slot = slotId
placement.crop = crop
placement.rooted = false
if (!farmWorld.putPlacement(placement)) {
farmWorld.notice("Could not stage that defender.")
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
return
}
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
})
return opened
}

function interactDefenderSlot(slotId: number): boolean {
if (!slotById(slotId)) return false
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
let placement = placementAt(progress, currentArea, slotId)
if (placement) {
if (placement.rooted) {
farmWorld.notice(cropDisplayName(placement.crop) + " is rooted here.")
return true
}
if (!isPrepPhase(progress, currentArea)) {
farmWorld.notice("Defender setup is closed.")
return true
}
if (farmWorld.removePlacement(currentArea, slotId)) {
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
} else {
farmWorld.notice("Could not pick up that defender.")
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
}
return true
}
return stageDefenderAtSlot(slotId)
}

function defenderAnchorX(defender: DefenderRuntime): number {
if (defender && defender.sprite) return defender.sprite.x
let slot = defender ? slotById(defender.slot) : null
return slot ? tileCenterX(slot.tile) : 0
}

function defenderAnchorY(defender: DefenderRuntime): number {
if (defender && defender.sprite) return defender.sprite.y
let slot = defender ? slotById(defender.slot) : null
return slot ? tileCenterY(slot.tile) : 0
}

function activeRootedDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
return defender != null && defender.epoch == epoch && defender.rooted && !defender.wilted && !defender.pendingDestroy && defender.hp > 0
}

function maskForSlotKindRadius(slotId: number, kind: number, radius: number): farmTypes.Mask {
if (!activeLayout) return null
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.masks.length; i++) {
let mask = activeLayout.masks[i]
if (mask.slot == slotId && mask.kind == kind && mask.radius == radius) return mask
}
return null
}

function maskCenter(mask: farmTypes.Mask): farmTypes.Point {
let point = new farmTypes.Point()
if (!mask || mask.tiles.length == 0) return point
let x = 0
let y = 0
for (let i = 0; i < mask.tiles.length; i++) {
x += tileCenterX(mask.tiles[i])
y += tileCenterY(mask.tiles[i])
}
point.x = Math.idiv(x, mask.tiles.length)
point.y = Math.idiv(y, mask.tiles.length)
return point
}

function validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy: EnemyRuntime, requiresGroundContact: boolean): boolean {
if (!enemy || enemy.epoch != epoch || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return false
if (!enemy.targetable || enemy.phased) return false
if (requiresGroundContact && !enemy.groundContact) return false
return true
}

function rangeTilesForSlot(slot: farmTypes.Slot, radiusTiles: number): number[] {
let empty: number[] = []
if (!slot) return empty
let mask = maskForSlotKindRadius(slot.id, 1, radiusTiles)
if (mask && mask.tiles.length > 0) return mask.tiles
return slot.rangeTiles
}

function enemyInDefenderRange(defender: DefenderRuntime, enemy: EnemyRuntime, radiusTiles: number, requiresGroundContact: boolean): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender) || !validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, requiresGroundContact)) return false
let slot = slotById(defender.slot)
if (!slot) return false
let tiles = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, radiusTiles)
return containsNumber(tiles, enemy.tile)
}

function candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime, requiresGroundContact: boolean, radiusTiles: number): EnemyRuntime[] {
let result: EnemyRuntime[] = []
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender)) return result
let slot = slotById(defender.slot)
if (!slot) return result
let tiles = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, radiusTiles)
let seen: number[] = []
for (let t = 0; t < tiles.length; t++) {
let ids = enemiesOnTile(tiles[t])
for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
if (containsNumber(seen, ids[i])) continue
let enemy = enemyById(ids[i])
if (!validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, requiresGroundContact)) continue
if (defender.previewOnly != enemy.previewOnly) continue
result.push(enemy)
seen.push(ids[i])
}
}
return result
}

function chooseNearestEnemyForDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime, radiusTiles: number): EnemyRuntime {
let candidates = candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender, false, radiusTiles)
let best: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestDistance = 1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let enemy = candidates[i]
let d2 = distanceSquared(defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
if (d2 < bestDistance || (d2 == bestDistance && (!best || enemy.id < best.id))) {
best = enemy
bestDistance = d2
}
}
return best
}

function chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime, greatest: boolean, avoidId: number, radiusTiles: number): EnemyRuntime {
let candidates = candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender, false, radiusTiles)
let best: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestProgress = greatest ? -1000000000 : 1000000000
let hasAlternative = false
if (avoidId >= 0) {
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
if (candidates[i].id != avoidId) {
hasAlternative = true
break
}
}
}
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let enemy = candidates[i]
if (hasAlternative && enemy.id == avoidId) continue
let progress = routeThreatProgress(enemy)
let better = greatest ? progress > bestProgress : progress < bestProgress
if (better || (progress == bestProgress && (!best || enemy.id < best.id))) {
best = enemy
bestProgress = progress
}
}
return best
}

function chooseSporecapTarget(defender: DefenderRuntime): EnemyRuntime {
let candidates = candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender, false, SPORECAP_RANGE_TILES)
let bestAir: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestAirProgress = -1000000000
let bestAny: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestAnyProgress = -1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let enemy = candidates[i]
let progress = routeThreatProgress(enemy)
if (progress > bestAnyProgress || (progress == bestAnyProgress && (!bestAny || enemy.id < bestAny.id))) {
bestAny = enemy
bestAnyProgress = progress
}
if (enemy.airborne && (progress > bestAirProgress || (progress == bestAirProgress && (!bestAir || enemy.id < bestAir.id)))) {
bestAir = enemy
bestAirProgress = progress
}
}
return bestAir ? bestAir : bestAny
}

function chooseRootsnareTarget(defender: DefenderRuntime): EnemyRuntime {
let candidates = candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender, true, ROOTSNARE_RANGE_TILES)
let reach = capturedUpgradeValue(farmWorld.progress(), farmTypes.Upgrade.SnareReach)
let contact = rootsnareMask(defender, reach)
if (!contact) return null
let best: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestProgress = -1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let enemy = candidates[i]
if (!containsNumber(contact.tiles, enemy.tile)) continue
let progress = routeThreatProgress(enemy)
if (progress > bestProgress || (progress == bestProgress && (!best || enemy.id < best.id))) {
best = enemy
bestProgress = progress
}
}
return best
}

function chooseStormbloomTarget(defender: DefenderRuntime): EnemyRuntime {
return chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, STORMBLOOM_RANGE_TILES)
}

function enemyConductive(enemy: EnemyRuntime): boolean {
if (!validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, false)) return false
if (enemy.species == 9) return true
if (enemy.species == 6) return enemy.shield > 0
if (enemy.species == 10) return enemy.specialActive && enemy.targetId >= 0
return false
}

function defenderHasPowerTarget(defender: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender)) return false
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter) return chooseNearestEnemyForDefender(defender, SIX_SHOOTER_RANGE_TILES) != null
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, TWINBUD_RANGE_TILES) != null
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) {
return chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, RAGE_RANGE_TILES) != null
}
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, PRISM_RANGE_TILES) != null
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) {
return defender.resource > 0 && chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, SUNBEAM_RANGE_TILES) != null
}
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) return echoHasGroundTarget(defender)
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return healrootHasDamagedAlly(defender)
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
return defender.resourceCap > 0 && defender.resource >= defender.resourceCap && chooseSporecapTarget(defender) != null
}
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) {
return defender.resource > 0 && totalCompatibleMissingEnergy(defender) > 0
}
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return chooseRootsnareTarget(defender) != null
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return chooseStormbloomTarget(defender) != null
return false
}

function defenderAtSlot(slotId: number): DefenderRuntime {
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (defender.slot == slotId && activeRootedDefender(defender)) return defender
}
return null
}

function damageDefender(defender: DefenderRuntime, damage: number): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender) || damage <= 0) return false
defender.hp = Math.max(0, defender.hp - damage)
if (defender.hp <= 0) {
defender.wilted = true
defender.engagedEnemyId = -1
defender.resource = Math.max(0, defender.resource)
if (defender.sprite) defender.sprite.setImage(farmArt.frame("crop." + cropArtStem(defender.crop) + ".wilted", 0))
}
return true
}

function candidateSlotsForEnemy(enemy: EnemyRuntime, leech: boolean): number[] {
let empty: number[] = []
if (!enemy) return empty
let lookup = reachLookupForTile(enemyRouteLookupTile(enemy))
if (!lookup) return empty
return leech ? lookup.leechSlots : lookup.hexSlots
}

function targetInRange(enemy: EnemyRuntime, defender: DefenderRuntime, rangeTiles: number): boolean {
if (!enemy || !activeRootedDefender(defender)) return false
let range = rangeTiles * TILE_SIZE
return distanceSquared(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender)) <= range * range
}

function chooseDefenderTarget(enemy: EnemyRuntime, leech: boolean): DefenderRuntime {
let candidates = candidateSlotsForEnemy(enemy, leech)
let best: DefenderRuntime = null
let bestDistance = 1000000000
let bestSlot = 1000000
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let defender = defenderAtSlot(candidates[i])
if (!defender) continue
if (leech && (defender.resourceCap <= 0 || defender.resource <= 0)) continue
let rangeTiles = leech ? MANA_LEECH_RANGE_TILES : HEX_MOTH_RANGE_TILES
if (!targetInRange(enemy, defender, rangeTiles)) continue
let d2 = distanceSquared(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender))
if (d2 < bestDistance || (d2 == bestDistance && defender.slot < bestSlot)) {
best = defender
bestDistance = d2
bestSlot = defender.slot
}
}
return best
}

function clearEnemySpecialTarget(enemy: EnemyRuntime): void {
if (!enemy) return
enemy.targetId = -1
enemy.specialActive = false
enemy.movementPaused = false
enemy.specialMs = 0
}

function enemyTargetDefender(enemy: EnemyRuntime): DefenderRuntime {
if (!enemy || enemy.targetId < 0) return null
return defenderById(enemy.targetId)
}

function showEnemyToDefenderEffect(enemy: EnemyRuntime, defender: DefenderRuntime, key: string, ttlMs: number, kind: number): void {
if (!enemy || !defender) return
let x = Math.idiv(enemy.visualX + defenderAnchorX(defender), 2)
let y = Math.idiv(enemy.visualY + defenderAnchorY(defender), 2)
let effect = createEffect(key, 0, ttlMs, x, y, kind)
if (effect) {
effect.sourceActorId = enemy.id
effect.targetActorId = defender.id
}
}

function updateHexMoth(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): void {
if (!enemy || enemy.species != 8 || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return
if (enemy.reachedObjective) {
clearEnemySpecialTarget(enemy)
return
}
let target = enemyTargetDefender(enemy)
if (!target || !targetInRange(enemy, target, HEX_MOTH_RANGE_TILES)) {
clearEnemySpecialTarget(enemy)
enemy.reacquireMs -= dtMs
if (enemy.reacquireMs <= 0) {
enemy.reacquireMs = HEX_MOTH_REACQUIRE_MS
target = chooseDefenderTarget(enemy, false)
if (target) {
enemy.targetId = target.id
enemy.specialActive = true
enemy.specialMs = HEX_MOTH_SHOT_INTERVAL_MS
}
}
}
target = enemyTargetDefender(enemy)
if (!target || !targetInRange(enemy, target, HEX_MOTH_RANGE_TILES)) return

enemy.movementPaused = true
enemy.specialActive = true
enemy.specialMs -= dtMs
if (enemy.specialMs > 0) return
showEnemyToDefenderEffect(enemy, target, "effect.shot", HEX_MOTH_EFFECT_MS, 801)
damageDefender(target, HEX_MOTH_DEFENDER_DAMAGE)
enemy.specialMs += HEX_MOTH_SHOT_INTERVAL_MS
if (enemy.specialMs <= 0) enemy.specialMs = HEX_MOTH_SHOT_INTERVAL_MS
if (!activeRootedDefender(target)) {
clearEnemySpecialTarget(enemy)
enemy.reacquireMs = 0
}
}

function updateManaLeech(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): void {
if (!enemy || enemy.species != 10 || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return
if (enemy.reachedObjective) {
clearEnemySpecialTarget(enemy)
return
}
let target = enemyTargetDefender(enemy)
if (!target || target.resourceCap <= 0 || target.resource <= 0 || !targetInRange(enemy, target, MANA_LEECH_RANGE_TILES)) {
clearEnemySpecialTarget(enemy)
enemy.reacquireMs -= dtMs
if (enemy.reacquireMs <= 0) {
enemy.reacquireMs = MANA_LEECH_REACQUIRE_MS
target = chooseDefenderTarget(enemy, true)
if (target) {
enemy.targetId = target.id
enemy.specialActive = true
enemy.specialMs = MANA_LEECH_DRAIN_INTERVAL_MS
}
}
}
target = enemyTargetDefender(enemy)
if (!target || target.resourceCap <= 0 || target.resource <= 0 || !targetInRange(enemy, target, MANA_LEECH_RANGE_TILES)) return

enemy.movementPaused = true
enemy.specialActive = true
enemy.specialMs -= dtMs
if (enemy.specialMs > 0) return
removeDefenderEnergy(target, MANA_LEECH_DRAIN_AMOUNT)
showEnemyToDefenderEffect(enemy, target, "effect.tether", MANA_LEECH_EFFECT_MS, 1001)
enemy.specialMs += MANA_LEECH_DRAIN_INTERVAL_MS
if (enemy.specialMs <= 0) enemy.specialMs = MANA_LEECH_DRAIN_INTERVAL_MS
if (target.resource <= 0) {
clearEnemySpecialTarget(enemy)
enemy.reacquireMs = 0
}
}

function setPhaseMiteState(enemy: EnemyRuntime, phased: boolean): void {
if (!enemy || enemy.species != 11) return
enemy.phased = phased
enemy.targetable = !phased
if (phased) {
enemy.controlHoldMs = 0
enemy.controlSlowMs = 0
enemy.controlSlowMultiplier = 1
}
enemy.phaseMs = phased ? PHASE_MITE_PHASED_MS : PHASE_MITE_SOLID_MS
createEffect("effect.phase", phased ? 1 : 0, PHASE_EFFECT_MS, enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY, 1101)
}

function updatePhaseMite(enemy: EnemyRuntime, dtMs: number): void {
if (!enemy || enemy.species != 11 || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) return
enemy.phaseMs -= dtMs
while (enemy.phaseMs <= 0) {
let over = -enemy.phaseMs
setPhaseMiteState(enemy, !enemy.phased)
enemy.phaseMs -= over
}
}

function updateEnemyControlTimers(dtMs: number): void {
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (!enemy || enemy.epoch != epoch || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) continue
if (enemy.controlHoldMs > 0) enemy.controlHoldMs = Math.max(0, enemy.controlHoldMs - dtMs)
if (enemy.controlSlowMs > 0) {
enemy.controlSlowMs = Math.max(0, enemy.controlSlowMs - dtMs)
if (enemy.controlSlowMs <= 0) enemy.controlSlowMultiplier = 1
}
}
}

function updateAdvancedEnemyStances(dtMs: number): void {
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (!enemy || enemy.epoch != epoch || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) continue
if (enemy.previewOnly) continue
enemy.movementPaused = false
if (enemy.species == 8) updateHexMoth(enemy, dtMs)
else if (enemy.species == 10) updateManaLeech(enemy, dtMs)
else if (enemy.species == 11) updatePhaseMite(enemy, dtMs)
}
}

function updateEnemyStates(dtMs: number): void {
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (!enemy || enemy.epoch != epoch || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy) continue
if (!enemy.previewOnly) {
updateRegenSlime(enemy, dtMs)
updateEnemyCropBite(enemy, dtMs)
}
animateEnemy(enemy, dtMs)
}
}

function updatePlayerFacing(): void {
let player = farmWorld.player()
if (!player) return
let vx = player.vx
let vy = player.vy
if (Math.abs(vx) < 0.01 && Math.abs(vy) < 0.01) return
if (Math.abs(vx) >= Math.abs(vy)) {
playerFacingX = vx < 0 ? -1 : 1
playerFacingY = 0
} else {
playerFacingX = 0
playerFacingY = vy < 0 ? -1 : 1
}
}

function weaponDamage(weapon: number): number {
return 3
}

function weaponReachPx(weapon: number): number {
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.LongHeavy) return 24
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.ShortQuick) return 12
return 16
}

function weaponCooldownMs(weapon: number): number {
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.LongHeavy) return 700
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.ShortQuick) return 280
return 450
}

function weaponSwingMs(weapon: number): number {
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.LongHeavy) return 220
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.ShortQuick) return 95
return 140
}

function weaponKnockbackPx(weapon: number): number {
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.LongHeavy) return 14
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.ShortQuick) return 5
return 8
}

function weaponArtKey(weapon: number): string {
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.LongHeavy) return "weapon.longheavy"
if (weapon == farmTypes.Weapon.ShortQuick) return "weapon.shortquick"
return "weapon.gardenblade"
}

function equippedOwnedWeapon(): number {
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!progress) return farmTypes.Weapon.GardenBlade
let weapon = progress.weapon
if (weapon < farmTypes.Weapon.GardenBlade || weapon > farmTypes.Weapon.ShortQuick) return farmTypes.Weapon.GardenBlade
if (!progress.weapons || weapon >= progress.weapons.length || progress.weapons[weapon] != 1) return farmTypes.Weapon.GardenBlade
return weapon
}

function enemyInsidePlayerSwing(enemy: EnemyRuntime, player: Sprite, reachPx: number): boolean {
if (!enemy || !player || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy || enemy.previewOnly) return false
let dx = enemy.visualX - player.x
let dy = enemy.visualY - player.y
let forward = dx * playerFacingX + dy * playerFacingY
if (forward < 0 || forward > reachPx) return false
let side = Math.abs(-playerFacingY * dx + playerFacingX * dy)
// Ten pixels gives the short forward arc enough width for ordinary 16 px
// sprites without turning it into a radial attack behind the player.
return side <= 10
}

function showWeaponSwing(player: Sprite, weapon: number): void {
if (!player) return
let reach = weaponReachPx(weapon)
let x = player.x + playerFacingX * Math.idiv(reach, 2)
let y = player.y + playerFacingY * Math.idiv(reach, 2)
createEffect(weaponArtKey(weapon), 0, weaponSwingMs(weapon), x, y, 100 + weapon)
}

function updatePlayerContactDamage(): void {
if (playerInvulnerableMs > 0) return
let player = farmWorld.player()
if (!player) return
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (!enemy || enemy.epoch != epoch || !enemy.alive || enemy.pendingDestroy || !enemy.sprite || enemy.previewOnly) continue
if (enemy.contactDamage <= 0) continue
// Use bounded center distance rather than a second overlap event handler;
// World remains the sole top-level input/update owner.
if (distanceSquared(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY, player.x, player.y) > 144) continue
farmWorld.changePlayerHp(-enemy.contactDamage)
playerInvulnerableMs = PLAYER_CONTACT_GATE_MS
// World remains HP authority. The binding seam amendment gives Combat a
// read-only observation so zero HP settles the active raid exactly once.
if (raidActive && farmWorld.playerHealth() <= 0) {
settleRaid(false)
return
}
break
}
}

function queueCommittedEnemyHit(targetId: number, travelMs: number, damage: number, damageType: number, groundOnly: boolean, knockbackPx: number, sourceX: number, sourceY: number): void {
if (targetId < 0) return
let hit = new PendingEnemyHit()
hit.epoch = epoch
hit.remainingMs = Math.max(1, travelMs)
hit.targetActorId = targetId
hit.damage = damage
hit.damageType = damageType
hit.groundOnly = groundOnly
hit.knockbackPx = knockbackPx
hit.sourceX = sourceX
hit.sourceY = sourceY
pendingEnemyHits.push(hit)
}

function updateCommittedEnemyHits(dtMs: number): void {
for (let i = pendingEnemyHits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
let hit = pendingEnemyHits[i]
if (!hit || hit.epoch != epoch) {
pendingEnemyHits.removeAt(i)
continue
}
hit.remainingMs -= dtMs
if (hit.remainingMs > 0) continue
let target = enemyById(hit.targetActorId)
// A committed projectile never silently substitutes a new target. If
// its original target is gone/invalid when it arrives, it expires.
if (target && target.alive && !target.pendingDestroy) {
applyEnemyEffect(target, hit.damage, hit.damageType, hit.groundOnly, hit.knockbackPx, hit.sourceX, hit.sourceY)
}
pendingEnemyHits.removeAt(i)
}
}

function updateEffects(dtMs: number): void {
for (let i = 0; i < effects.length; i++) {
let effect = effects[i]
if (effect.epoch != epoch || effect.pendingDestroy) continue
effect.ageMs += dtMs
if (effect.sprite && effect.artKey.length > 0 && effect.frameCount > 1 && effect.frameMs > 0) {
let frame = Math.idiv(effect.ageMs, effect.frameMs)
if (frame >= effect.frameCount) frame = effect.frameCount - 1
effect.sprite.setImage(farmArt.frame(effect.artKey, frame))
}
if (effect.ttlMs > 0) {
effect.ttlMs -= dtMs
if (effect.ttlMs <= 0) markEffectForDestroy(effect.id)
}
}
}

function createEffect(key: string, frame: number, ttlMs: number, x: number, y: number, kind: number): EffectRuntime {
if (!entered || liveEffectCount() >= MAX_LIVE_EFFECTS) return null
let sprite = sprites.create(farmArt.frame(key, frame), ProjectileKind)
sprite.setPosition(x, y)
sprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)

let effect = new EffectRuntime()
effect.id = nextEffectId
nextEffectId += 1
effect.kind = kind
effect.sprite = sprite
effect.epoch = epoch
effect.ttlMs = ttlMs
effect.capturedX = x
effect.capturedY = y
effect.artKey = key
effect.ageMs = 0
effect.frameMs = farmArt.frameMs(key)
let frames = farmArt.frames(key)
effect.frameCount = frames && frames.length > 0 ? frames.length : 1
effects.push(effect)
return effect
}

function setDefenderAttackImage(defender: DefenderRuntime): void {
if (!defender || !defender.sprite || defender.wilted) return
defender.sprite.setImage(farmArt.frame("crop." + cropArtStem(defender.crop) + ".attack", 0))
}

function restoreDefenderImage(defender: DefenderRuntime): void {
if (!defender || !defender.sprite) return
let state = defender.wilted ? "wilted" : "rooted"
defender.sprite.setImage(farmArt.frame("crop." + cropArtStem(defender.crop) + "." + state, 0))
}

function contextAimX(context: farmTypes.Context, alternate: boolean): number {
if (!context) return 0
let index = alternate ? TD_ALT_AIM_X : TD_LAST_AIM_X
if (context.data.length <= index) return 0
return context.data[index]
}

function contextAimY(context: farmTypes.Context, alternate: boolean): number {
if (!context) return 0
let index = alternate ? TD_ALT_AIM_Y : TD_LAST_AIM_Y
if (context.data.length <= index) return 0
return context.data[index]
}

function setContextAim(context: farmTypes.Context, alternate: boolean, x: number, y: number): void {
if (!context) return
let xi = alternate ? TD_ALT_AIM_X : TD_LAST_AIM_X
let yi = alternate ? TD_ALT_AIM_Y : TD_LAST_AIM_Y
if (context.data.length > yi) {
context.data[xi] = x
context.data[yi] = y
}
}

function defaultAimX(defender: DefenderRuntime): number {
return defenderAnchorX(defender) + TILE_SIZE
}

function defaultAimY(defender: DefenderRuntime): number {
return defenderAnchorY(defender)
}

function fireCommittedSeed(context: farmTypes.Context, defender: DefenderRuntime, target: EnemyRuntime, alternateAim: boolean, damage: number, knockbackPx: number, speedPxPerSec: number): number {
if (!defender) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
let sourceX = defenderAnchorX(defender)
let sourceY = defenderAnchorY(defender)
let targetId = -1
let aimX = contextAimX(context, alternateAim)
let aimY = contextAimY(context, alternateAim)
if (target) {
targetId = target.id
aimX = target.visualX
aimY = target.visualY
setContextAim(context, alternateAim, aimX, aimY)
} else if (aimX == 0 && aimY == 0) {
aimX = defaultAimX(defender)
aimY = defaultAimY(defender)
setContextAim(context, alternateAim, aimX, aimY)
}

let dx = aimX - sourceX
let dy = aimY - sourceY
let distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
if (distance < 1) distance = TILE_SIZE
let speed = Math.max(1, speedPxPerSec)
let travelMs = Math.max(1, Math.round(distance * 1000 / speed))
let effect = createEffect("effect.shot", 0, travelMs + 80, sourceX, sourceY, 0)
if (effect && effect.sprite) {
let length = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
if (length <= 0.01) {
effect.sprite.vx = speed
effect.sprite.vy = 0
} else {
effect.sprite.vx = dx / length * speed
effect.sprite.vy = dy / length * speed
}
effect.sourceActorId = defender.id
effect.targetActorId = targetId
effect.capturedX = aimX
effect.capturedY = aimY
}

pause(travelMs)
if (targetId < 0) return OUT_VISUAL_NO_TARGET
let currentTarget = enemyById(targetId)
if (!currentTarget) return OUT_STALE_TARGET
let result = applyEnemyEffect(currentTarget, damage, DAMAGE_ORDINARY, false, knockbackPx, sourceX, sourceY)
return result.outcome
}

function mineMaskForPatch(slotId: number, patch: number): farmTypes.Mask {
if (!activeLayout || patch < 0) return null
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.masks.length; i++) {
let mask = activeLayout.masks[i]
if (mask.slot != slotId || mask.kind != 2) continue
// Art owns one ordered patch window, not one mask per primitive.
// One NEXT/DROP pair affects exactly its indexed authored tile.
if (patch >= mask.tiles.length) return null
let selected = new farmTypes.Mask()
selected.slot = mask.slot; selected.kind = mask.kind; selected.radius = mask.radius
selected.tiles = [mask.tiles[patch]]
return selected
}
return null
}

function mineByActorPatch(actorId: number, patch: number): MineRuntime {
for (let i = 0; i < mines.length; i++) {
let mine = mines[i]
if (mine.epoch == epoch && mine.actorId == actorId && mine.patch == patch && mine.armed) return mine
}
return null
}

function armMine(defender: DefenderRuntime, patch: number, mask: farmTypes.Mask): boolean {
if (!defender || !mask || mask.tiles.length == 0 || mineByActorPatch(defender.id, patch)) return false
let center = maskCenter(mask)
let mine = new MineRuntime()
mine.actorId = defender.id
mine.patch = patch
mine.epoch = epoch
mine.x = center.x
mine.y = center.y
for (let i = 0; i < mask.tiles.length; i++) mine.tiles.push(mask.tiles[i])
let effect = createEffect("effect.mine", 0, 0, mine.x, mine.y, 0)
mine.effectId = effect ? effect.id : -1
mines.push(mine)
return true
}

function mineContainsValidEnemy(mine: MineRuntime): boolean {
if (!mine || !mine.armed || mine.epoch != epoch) return false
for (let t = 0; t < mine.tiles.length; t++) {
let ids = enemiesOnTile(mine.tiles[t])
for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemyById(ids[i])
if (validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, true)) return true
}
}
return false
}

function detonateMine(mine: MineRuntime): void {
if (!mine || !mine.armed || mine.epoch != epoch) return
mine.armed = false
let hitIds: number[] = []
for (let t = 0; t < mine.tiles.length; t++) {
let ids = enemiesOnTile(mine.tiles[t])
for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
if (containsNumber(hitIds, ids[i])) continue
let enemy = enemyById(ids[i])
if (!validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemy, true)) continue
hitIds.push(ids[i])
applyEnemyEffect(enemy, MINEBERRY_DAMAGE, DAMAGE_ORDINARY, true, MINEBERRY_KNOCKBACK_PX, mine.x, mine.y)
}
}
if (mine.effectId >= 0) markEffectForDestroy(mine.effectId)
createEffect("effect.mine", 0, MINEBERRY_EFFECT_MS, mine.x, mine.y, 0)
}

function updateMines(): void {
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_ACTIVE) return
for (let i = 0; i < mines.length; i++) {
let mine = mines[i]
if (!mine.armed || mine.epoch != epoch) continue
if (mineContainsValidEnemy(mine)) detonateMine(mine)
}
}


function maskForOriginTile(kind: number, originTile: number): farmTypes.Mask {
if (!activeLayout || originTile < 0) return null
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.masks.length; i++) {
let mask = activeLayout.masks[i]
if (mask.kind == kind && mask.slot == originTile) return mask
}
return null
}

function snapshotOffset(index: number): number {
return TD_SNAPSHOT_BASE + index * TD_SNAPSHOT_STRIDE
}

function clearSnapshot(context: farmTypes.Context): void {
if (!context) return
while (context.data.length <= snapshotOffset(TD_SNAPSHOT_MAX - 1) + 2) context.data.push(0)
context.data[TD_SNAPSHOT_COUNT] = 0
for (let i = 0; i < TD_SNAPSHOT_MAX; i++) {
let o = snapshotOffset(i)
context.data[o] = -1
context.data[o + 1] = 0
context.data[o + 2] = 0
}
}

function setSnapshotEntry(context: farmTypes.Context, index: number, id: number, x: number, y: number): void {
if (!context || index < 0 || index >= TD_SNAPSHOT_MAX) return
let o = snapshotOffset(index)
while (context.data.length <= o + 2) context.data.push(0)
context.data[o] = id
context.data[o + 1] = x
context.data[o + 2] = y
}

function snapshotId(context: farmTypes.Context, index: number): number {
if (!context || index < 0 || index >= TD_SNAPSHOT_MAX) return -1
let o = snapshotOffset(index)
return context.data.length > o ? context.data[o] : -1
}

function snapshotX(context: farmTypes.Context, index: number): number {
if (!context || index < 0 || index >= TD_SNAPSHOT_MAX) return 0
let o = snapshotOffset(index)
return context.data.length > o + 1 ? context.data[o + 1] : 0
}

function snapshotY(context: farmTypes.Context, index: number): number {
if (!context || index < 0 || index >= TD_SNAPSHOT_MAX) return 0
let o = snapshotOffset(index)
return context.data.length > o + 2 ? context.data[o + 2] : 0
}

function buildPrismSnapshot(context: farmTypes.Context, defender: DefenderRuntime): void {
clearSnapshot(context)
if (!context || !defender) return
let limit = Math.min(TD_SNAPSHOT_MAX, Math.max(0, contextPrimaryValue(context)))
let candidates = candidateEnemiesForDefender(defender, false, PRISM_RANGE_TILES)
let selected: number[] = []
for (let slot = 0; slot < limit; slot++) {
let best: EnemyRuntime = null
let bestProgress = -1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
let enemy = candidates[i]
if (containsNumber(selected, enemy.id)) continue
let progress = routeThreatProgress(enemy)
if (progress > bestProgress || (progress == bestProgress && (!best || enemy.id < best.id))) {
best = enemy
bestProgress = progress
}
}
if (!best) break
selected.push(best.id)
setSnapshotEntry(context, slot, best.id, best.visualX, best.visualY)
context.data[TD_SNAPSHOT_COUNT] += 1
createEffect("effect.threat", 0, 900, best.visualX, best.visualY - 6, 0)
}
}

function echoMask(defender: DefenderRuntime, radius: number): farmTypes.Mask {
if (!defender || radius <= 0) return null
return maskForSlotKindRadius(defender.slot, 4, radius)
}

function echoHasGroundTarget(defender: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender)) return false
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
let level = upgradeLevel(progress, farmTypes.Upgrade.PulseLevels)
let maxRadius = farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.PulseLevels, level)
for (let radius = 1; radius <= maxRadius; radius++) {
let mask = echoMask(defender, radius)
if (!mask) continue
for (let t = 0; t < mask.tiles.length; t++) {
let ids = enemiesOnTile(mask.tiles[t])
for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
if (validDefenderEnemyTarget(enemyById(ids[i]), true)) return true
}
}
}
return false
}

function defenderInsideHealrootRange(source: DefenderRuntime, target: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(source) || !activeRootedDefender(target) || source.id == target.id) return false
if (source.previewOnly != target.previewOnly) return false
let sourceSlot = slotById(source.slot)
if (!sourceSlot) return false
let targetSlot = slotById(target.slot)
return targetSlot != null && containsNumber(sourceSlot.neighbors, targetSlot.id)
}

function healrootHasDamagedAlly(defender: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender)) return false
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let ally = defenders[i]
if (!defenderInsideHealrootRange(defender, ally)) continue
if (ally.hp > 0 && ally.hp < ally.maxHp) return true
}
return false
}

function buildHealrootSnapshot(context: farmTypes.Context, defender: DefenderRuntime): void {
clearSnapshot(context)
if (!context || !defender) return
let limit = Math.min(TD_SNAPSHOT_MAX, Math.max(0, contextPrimaryValue(context)))
let selected: number[] = []
for (let slotIndex = 0; slotIndex < limit; slotIndex++) {
let best: DefenderRuntime = null
let bestDistance = 1000000000
let bestSlot = 1000000
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let ally = defenders[i]
if (!defenderInsideHealrootRange(defender, ally) || containsNumber(selected, ally.id)) continue
let d2 = distanceSquared(defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), defenderAnchorX(ally), defenderAnchorY(ally))
if (d2 < bestDistance || (d2 == bestDistance && ally.slot < bestSlot)) {
best = ally
bestDistance = d2
bestSlot = ally.slot
}
}
if (best) {
selected.push(best.id)
setSnapshotEntry(context, slotIndex, best.id, defenderAnchorX(best), defenderAnchorY(best))
} else {
setSnapshotEntry(context, slotIndex, -1, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender))
}
context.data[TD_SNAPSHOT_COUNT] += 1
}
}

function runnerActiveForActor(task: number, actorId: number): boolean {
let active = activeRunnerForTask(task)
return active != null && active.actorId == actorId
}

function isEnergyBearingCrop(crop: number): boolean {
return crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam || crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap || crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf
}

function sporeLoadedCount(defender: DefenderRuntime): number {
if (!defender || defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return 0
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < defender.sporeLoaded.length; i++) if (defender.sporeLoaded[i] != 0) count += 1
return count
}

function syncSporeResource(defender: DefenderRuntime): void {
if (!defender || defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return
defender.resource = Math.max(0, Math.min(defender.resourceCap, sporeLoadedCount(defender)))
}

function removeDefenderEnergy(defender: DefenderRuntime, amount: number): number {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender) || amount <= 0 || defender.resourceCap <= 0) return 0
let removed = 0
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
for (let unit = 0; unit < amount; unit++) {
let index = -1
if (defender.sporeActive) {
for (let i = Math.max(0, defender.sporeNextIndex); i < defender.sporeLoaded.length; i++) {
if (defender.sporeLoaded[i] != 0) { index = i; break }
}
}
if (index < 0) {
for (let i = 0; i < defender.sporeLoaded.length; i++) {
if (defender.sporeLoaded[i] != 0) { index = i; break }
}
}
if (index < 0) break
defender.sporeLoaded[index] = 0
removed += 1
}
syncSporeResource(defender)
return removed
}
removed = Math.min(amount, Math.max(0, defender.resource))
defender.resource -= removed
return removed
}

function addDefenderEnergy(defender: DefenderRuntime, amount: number): number {
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender) || amount <= 0 || defender.resourceCap <= 0) return 0
let added = 0
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
for (let unit = 0; unit < amount; unit++) {
let index = -1
if (defender.sporeActive) {
for (let i = Math.max(0, defender.sporeNextIndex); i < defender.sporeLoaded.length; i++) {
if (defender.sporeLoaded[i] == 0) { index = i; break }
}
}
if (index < 0) {
for (let i = 0; i < defender.sporeLoaded.length; i++) {
if (defender.sporeLoaded[i] == 0) { index = i; break }
}
}
if (index < 0) break
defender.sporeLoaded[index] = 1
added += 1
}
syncSporeResource(defender)
return added
}
let room = Math.max(0, defender.resourceCap - defender.resource)
added = Math.min(amount, room)
defender.resource += added
return added
}

function compatibleEnergyRecipient(source: DefenderRuntime, target: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
if (!activeRootedDefender(source) || !activeRootedDefender(target) || source.id == target.id) return false
if (source.previewOnly != target.previewOnly) return false
if (!isEnergyBearingCrop(target.crop) || target.resourceCap <= 0 || target.resource >= target.resourceCap) return false
let range = LANTERNLEAF_RANGE_TILES * TILE_SIZE
return distanceSquared(defenderAnchorX(source), defenderAnchorY(source), defenderAnchorX(target), defenderAnchorY(target)) <= range * range
}

function totalCompatibleMissingEnergy(source: DefenderRuntime): number {
if (!activeRootedDefender(source)) return 0
let total = 0
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let target = defenders[i]
if (!compatibleEnergyRecipient(source, target)) continue
total += Math.max(0, target.resourceCap - target.resource)
}
return total
}

function chooseLanternleafRecipient(source: DefenderRuntime): DefenderRuntime {
let best: DefenderRuntime = null
let bestMissing = -1
let bestCap = 1
let bestDistance = 1000000000
let bestSlot = 1000000
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let target = defenders[i]
if (!compatibleEnergyRecipient(source, target)) continue
let missing = target.resourceCap - target.resource
let d2 = distanceSquared(defenderAnchorX(source), defenderAnchorY(source), defenderAnchorX(target), defenderAnchorY(target))
let fractionBetter = !best || missing * bestCap > bestMissing * target.resourceCap
let fractionEqual = best && missing * bestCap == bestMissing * target.resourceCap
if (fractionBetter || (fractionEqual && (d2 < bestDistance || (d2 == bestDistance && target.slot < bestSlot)))) {
best = target
bestMissing = missing
bestCap = target.resourceCap
bestDistance = d2
bestSlot = target.slot
}
}
return best
}

function updateEnergyRecharge(dtMs: number): void {
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender) || defender.resourceCap <= 0) continue
if (defender.previewOnly) continue
if (defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam && defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap && defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) continue
if (defender.resource >= defender.resourceCap) {
defender.resource = defender.resourceCap
defender.resourceMs = 0
continue
}
if (runnerActiveForActor(taskForCrop(defender.crop), defender.id)) continue
let interval = SUNBEAM_RECHARGE_INTERVAL_MS
if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) interval = SPORECAP_SAC_RECHARGE_MS
else if (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) interval = LANTERNLEAF_RECHARGE_MS
defender.resourceMs += dtMs
while (defender.resourceMs >= interval && defender.resource < defender.resourceCap) {
defender.resourceMs -= interval
if (addDefenderEnergy(defender, 1) <= 0) break
let key = defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam ? "effect.beam" : (defender.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap ? "effect.spore" : "effect.energy")
createEffect(key, 0, 140, defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender) - 5, 0)
}
if (defender.resource >= defender.resourceCap) defender.resourceMs = 0
}
}

function powerCooldownMs(crop: number): number {
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter) return SIX_SHOOTER_RELOAD_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return TWINBUD_COOLDOWN_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) return RAGE_REENGAGE_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return PRISM_COOLDOWN_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) return SUNBEAM_DISCHARGE_CHECK_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) return ECHO_COOLDOWN_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return HEALROOT_COOLDOWN_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return SPORECAP_COOLDOWN_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) return LANTERNLEAF_COOLDOWN_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return ROOTSNARE_COOLDOWN_MS
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return STORMBLOOM_COOLDOWN_MS
return 0
}

function updateDefenderPowerTriggers(dtMs: number): void {
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender)) continue
if (defender.actionMs > 0) defender.actionMs = Math.max(0, defender.actionMs - dtMs)
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_ACTIVE || defender.actionMs > 0) continue
if (defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter && defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud && defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Rage &&
defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Prism && defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam && defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Echo &&
defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Healroot && defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap && defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf &&
defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare && defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) continue
if (runnerRequestExists(taskForCrop(defender.crop), defender.id)) continue
if (!defenderHasPowerTarget(defender)) continue
enqueuePowerRun(defender.crop, defender.id, farmTypes.Mode.Raid)
}
}

function runtimeSlotOccupied(slotId: number): boolean {
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (defender && defender.epoch == epoch && !defender.pendingDestroy && defender.slot == slotId) return true
}
return false
}

function practicePadForCrop(crop: number): farmTypes.WorldObject {
if (!activeLayout) return null
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.objects.length; i++) {
let object = activeLayout.objects[i]
if (object && object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.PracticePad && object.arg == crop) return object
}
return null
}

function previewMaskCount(slotId: number, kind: number): number {
if (!activeLayout) return 0
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.masks.length; i++) {
let mask = activeLayout.masks[i]
if (mask.slot == slotId && mask.kind == kind && mask.tiles.length > 0) count += 1
}
return count
}

function previewRangeRadius(crop: number): number {
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) return RAGE_RANGE_TILES
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return PRISM_RANGE_TILES
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) return SUNBEAM_RANGE_TILES
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return HEALROOT_RANGE_TILES
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return SPORECAP_RANGE_TILES
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) return LANTERNLEAF_RANGE_TILES
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return ROOTSNARE_RANGE_TILES
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return STORMBLOOM_RANGE_TILES
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return TWINBUD_RANGE_TILES
return SIX_SHOOTER_RANGE_TILES
}

function previewFreeNearbySlotCount(slot: farmTypes.Slot, radius: number): number {
if (!slot || !activeLayout) return 0
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.defenderSlots.length; i++) {
let candidate = activeLayout.defenderSlots[i]
if (!candidate || candidate.id == slot.id || runtimeSlotOccupied(candidate.id)) continue
if (containsNumber(slot.neighbors, candidate.id) &&
(radius == HEALROOT_RANGE_TILES || distanceSquared(tileCenterX(slot.tile), tileCenterY(slot.tile), tileCenterX(candidate.tile), tileCenterY(candidate.tile)) <= radius * radius * TILE_SIZE * TILE_SIZE)) count += 1
}
return count
}

function previewPrismOriginCount(slot: farmTypes.Slot): number {
if (!slot) return 0
let tiles = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, PRISM_RANGE_TILES)
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < tiles.length; i++) {
let mask = maskForOriginTile(3, tiles[i])
if (mask && mask.tiles.length > 0) count += 1
}
return count
}

function previewSlotSupports(crop: number, slot: farmTypes.Slot, primary: number, secondary: number): boolean {
if (!slot || runtimeSlotOccupied(slot.id)) return false
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry) return mineMaskForPatch(slot.id, primary - 1) != null
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) {
for (let radius = 1; radius <= primary; radius++) {
let mask = maskForSlotKindRadius(slot.id, 4, radius)
if (!mask || mask.tiles.length == 0) return false
}
return true
}
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) {
let mask = maskForSlotKindRadius(slot.id, 5, primary)
if (!mask || mask.tiles.length == 0) return false
}
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) {
let sawGustMask = false
for (let i = 0; activeLayout && i < activeLayout.masks.length; i++) {
let mask = activeLayout.masks[i]
if (mask.slot == slot.id && mask.kind == 6 && mask.tiles.length > 0) { sawGustMask = true; break }
}
if (!sawGustMask) return false
}
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism && previewPrismOriginCount(slot) < primary) return false
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot && previewFreeNearbySlotCount(slot, HEALROOT_RANGE_TILES) < Math.max(0, primary - 1)) return false
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) {
if (previewFreeNearbySlotCount(slot, LANTERNLEAF_RANGE_TILES) < 3) return false
let energyNeighbors = 0
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.defenderSlots.length; i++) {
let candidate = activeLayout.defenderSlots[i]
if (runtimeSlotOccupied(candidate.id) || !containsNumber(slot.neighbors, candidate.id)) continue
let radius = LANTERNLEAF_RANGE_TILES * TILE_SIZE
if (distanceSquared(tileCenterX(slot.tile), tileCenterY(slot.tile), tileCenterX(candidate.tile), tileCenterY(candidate.tile)) <= radius * radius) energyNeighbors++
}
if (energyNeighbors < 2) return false
}
let range = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, previewRangeRadius(crop))
return range && range.length > 0
}

function choosePreviewSlot(crop: number, pad: farmTypes.WorldObject, primary: number, secondary: number): farmTypes.Slot {
if (!activeLayout) return null
let anchorX = activeLayout.entry ? activeLayout.entry.x : 0
let anchorY = activeLayout.entry ? activeLayout.entry.y : 0
if (pad) { anchorX = pad.x; anchorY = pad.y }
else {
let player = farmWorld.player()
if (player) { anchorX = player.x; anchorY = player.y }
}
let best: farmTypes.Slot = null
let bestDistance = 1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.defenderSlots.length; i++) {
let slot = activeLayout.defenderSlots[i]
if (!previewSlotSupports(crop, slot, primary, secondary)) continue
let d2 = distanceSquared(anchorX, anchorY, tileCenterX(slot.tile), tileCenterY(slot.tile))
if (d2 < bestDistance || (d2 == bestDistance && (!best || slot.id < best.id))) {
best = slot
bestDistance = d2
}
}
return best
}

function createPreviewDefender(crop: number, slotId: number): DefenderRuntime {
let slot = slotById(slotId)
if (!slot || !validCrop(crop)) return null
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
let defender = new DefenderRuntime()
defender.id = nextActorId++
defender.crop = crop
defender.slot = slotId
defender.epoch = epoch
defender.maxHp = defenderMaxHp(crop)
defender.hp = defender.maxHp
defender.rooted = true
defender.wilted = false
defender.pendingDestroy = false
defender.previewOnly = true
defender.resourceCap = defenderResourceCapacity(crop, progress)
defender.resource = defender.resourceCap
defender.resourceMs = 0
defender.actionMs = 0
defender.engagedEnemyId = -1
defender.sporeLoaded = []
defender.sporeActive = false
defender.sporeNextIndex = 0
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
for (let i = 0; i < defender.resourceCap; i++) defender.sporeLoaded.push(1)
}
defender.sprite = sprites.create(farmArt.frame("crop." + cropArtStem(crop) + ".rooted", 0), DefenderKind)
defender.sprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
defender.sprite.setPosition(tileCenterX(slot.tile), tileCenterY(slot.tile))
defenders.push(defender)
previewDefenderIds.push(defender.id)
return defender
}

function createPreviewEnemy(species: number, tile: number, threat: number): EnemyRuntime {
if (!validTile(tile) || species < 1 || species > 13 || aliveEnemyCount() >= MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) return null
let sprite = sprites.create(farmArt.frame(speciesMoveArtKey(species), 0), EnemyKind)
sprite.setFlag(SpriteFlag.Ghost, true)
let enemy = new EnemyRuntime()
enemy.id = nextActorId++
enemy.species = species
enemy.sprite = sprite
enemy.epoch = epoch
enemy.generation = species == 13 ? 1 : 0
configureEnemyMovement(enemy, species)
configureEnemyCombat(enemy, species)
enemy.previewOnly = true
enemy.previewThreat = Math.max(0, threat)
enemy.movementPaused = true
enemy.routeId = -1
enemy.routeIndex = -1
enemy.routeProgress = 0
enemy.reachedObjective = false
enemy.objectiveCropSlot = -1
enemy.visualX = tileCenterX(tile)
enemy.visualY = tileCenterY(tile)
sprite.setPosition(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
enemies.push(enemy)
setEnemyTile(enemy, tile)
previewEnemyIds.push(enemy.id)
return enemy
}

function setPreviewEnemyHp(enemy: EnemyRuntime, hp: number): void {
if (!enemy) return
enemy.maxHp = Math.max(1, hp)
enemy.hp = enemy.maxHp
}

function previewRangeTile(defender: DefenderRuntime, radius: number, index: number): number {
if (!defender) return -1
let slot = slotById(defender.slot)
if (!slot) return -1
let tiles = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, radius)
if (!tiles || tiles.length == 0) return -1
// Choose the Nth nearest authored tile so repeated teaching shots do not
// begin at the extreme edge of range and get knocked out by their own
// small feedback displacement. Ties are stable by tile id.
let used: number[] = []
let wanted = Math.max(0, index)
for (let pick = 0; pick <= wanted; pick++) {
let best = -1
let bestDistance = 1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < tiles.length; i++) {
let tile = tiles[i]
if (!validTile(tile) || containsNumber(used, tile)) continue
let d2 = distanceSquared(defenderAnchorX(defender), defenderAnchorY(defender), tileCenterX(tile), tileCenterY(tile))
if (d2 < bestDistance || (d2 == bestDistance && (best < 0 || tile < best))) {
best = tile
bestDistance = d2
}
}
if (best < 0) break
used.push(best)
}
return used.length > wanted ? used[wanted] : (used.length > 0 ? used[used.length - 1] : -1)
}

function previewOutsideRangeTile(defender: DefenderRuntime, radius: number): number {
if (!defender || !activeLayout) return -1
let slot = slotById(defender.slot)
if (!slot) return -1
let inside = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, radius)
for (let r = 0; r < activeRoutes.length; r++) {
let route = activeRoutes[r]
for (let i = route.tiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
if (!containsNumber(inside, route.tiles[i])) return route.tiles[i]
}
}
let total = activeLayout.width * activeLayout.height
for (let tile = total - 1; tile >= 0; tile--) {
if (!containsNumber(inside, tile)) return tile
}
return -1
}

function previewNearbyFreeSlots(source: DefenderRuntime, radius: number, maximum: number): farmTypes.Slot[] {
let result: farmTypes.Slot[] = []
if (!source || !activeLayout || maximum <= 0) return result
let sourceSlot = slotById(source.slot)
if (!sourceSlot) return result
let used: number[] = []
for (let pick = 0; pick < maximum; pick++) {
let best: farmTypes.Slot = null
let bestDistance = 1000000000
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.defenderSlots.length; i++) {
let slot = activeLayout.defenderSlots[i]
if (!slot || slot.id == source.slot || runtimeSlotOccupied(slot.id) || containsNumber(used, slot.id)) continue
if (!containsNumber(sourceSlot.neighbors, slot.id)) continue
let d2 = distanceSquared(defenderAnchorX(source), defenderAnchorY(source), tileCenterX(slot.tile), tileCenterY(slot.tile))
if (d2 < bestDistance || (d2 == bestDistance && (!best || slot.id < best.id))) {
best = slot
bestDistance = d2
}
}
if (!best) break
result.push(best)
used.push(best.id)
}
return result
}

function previewPrismTiles(source: DefenderRuntime, count: number): number[] {
let result: number[] = []
if (!source || count <= 0) return result
let slot = slotById(source.slot)
if (!slot) return result
let tiles = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, PRISM_RANGE_TILES)
for (let i = 0; i < tiles.length && result.length < count; i++) {
if (!validTile(tiles[i]) || containsNumber(result, tiles[i])) continue
let mask = maskForOriginTile(3, tiles[i])
if (mask && mask.tiles.length > 0) result.push(tiles[i])
}
return result
}

function previewStormTile(source: DefenderRuntime): number {
if (!source || !activeLayout) return -1
let slot = slotById(source.slot)
if (!slot) return -1
let range = rangeTilesForSlot(slot, STORMBLOOM_RANGE_TILES)
for (let i = 0; i < activeLayout.masks.length; i++) {
let mask = activeLayout.masks[i]
if (mask.slot != source.slot || mask.kind != 6) continue
for (let t = 0; t < mask.tiles.length; t++) {
if (containsNumber(range, mask.tiles[t])) return mask.tiles[t]
}
}
return -1
}

function previewAnatomyMessage(crop: number, primary: number, secondary: number): string {
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter) return "Practice: " + primary + " loaded chambers."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return "Practice: " + primary + " left-right cycles."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry) return "Practice: " + primary + " trap patches."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) return "Practice: starting damage " + primary + "."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return "Practice: " + primary + " marked targets."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) return "Practice: " + primary + " sunlight."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) return "Practice: pulse rings 1 through " + primary + "."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return "Practice: " + primary + " ally slots."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return "Practice: " + primary + " caps x " + secondary + " spores."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) return "Practice: charge only compatible energy allies."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return "Practice: snare reach " + primary + " tile(s)."
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return "Projection: " + primary + " bulbs x " + secondary + " sparks."
return "Power practice."
}

function setupPreviewSixShooter(source: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
let tile = previewRangeTile(source, SIX_SHOOTER_RANGE_TILES, 0)
let target = createPreviewEnemy(1, tile, 10)
if (!target) return false
setPreviewEnemyHp(target, 20)
return true
}

function setupPreviewTwinbud(source: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
let a = createPreviewEnemy(1, previewRangeTile(source, TWINBUD_RANGE_TILES, 0), 20)
let b = createPreviewEnemy(1, previewRangeTile(source, TWINBUD_RANGE_TILES, 1), 5)
if (!a || !b) return false
setPreviewEnemyHp(a, 40)
setPreviewEnemyHp(b, 40)
return true
}

function setupPreviewRage(source: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
let tile = previewRangeTile(source, RAGE_RANGE_TILES, 0)
let target = createPreviewEnemy(1, tile, 10)
if (!target) return false
setPreviewEnemyHp(target, 100)
previewExitEnemyId = target.id
previewExitAtMs = 1900
previewExitTile = previewOutsideRangeTile(source, RAGE_RANGE_TILES)
return previewExitTile >= 0
}

function setupPreviewPrism(source: DefenderRuntime, count: number): boolean {
let tiles = previewPrismTiles(source, count)
if (tiles.length < count) return false
for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
let armored = i == 0 || i == 3
let enemy = createPreviewEnemy(armored ? 5 : 1, tiles[i], (count - i) * 10)
if (!enemy) return false
setPreviewEnemyHp(enemy, 40)
}
return true
}

function setupPreviewSunbeam(source: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
let target = createPreviewEnemy(1, previewRangeTile(source, SUNBEAM_RANGE_TILES, 0), 10)
if (!target) return false
setPreviewEnemyHp(target, 100)
return true
}

function setupPreviewEcho(source: DefenderRuntime, count: number): boolean {
let firstTile = -1
for (let radius = 1; radius <= count; radius++) {
let mask = echoMask(source, radius)
if (!mask || mask.tiles.length == 0) return false
let tile = mask.tiles[0]
if (radius == 1) firstTile = tile
let target = createPreviewEnemy(1, tile, count - radius + 1)
if (!target) return false
setPreviewEnemyHp(target, 20)
}
// One airborne actor shares the inner band and visibly ignores a ground ring.
let wisp = createPreviewEnemy(9, firstTile, count + 2)
if (!wisp) return false
setPreviewEnemyHp(wisp, 20)
return true
}

function setupPreviewHealroot(source: DefenderRuntime, count: number): boolean {
let slots = previewNearbyFreeSlots(source, HEALROOT_RANGE_TILES, Math.max(0, count - 1))
if (slots.length < Math.max(0, count - 1)) return false
for (let i = 0; i < slots.length; i++) {
let ally = createPreviewDefender(farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter, slots[i].id)
if (!ally) return false
// Stable preview order: damaged, healthy, damaged, healthy; final
// purchased tendril position remains an actual empty snapshot slot.
if (i == 0 || i == 2) ally.hp = Math.max(1, ally.maxHp - HEALROOT_HEAL_AMOUNT)
}
return true
}

function setupPreviewSporecap(source: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
let air = createPreviewEnemy(9, previewRangeTile(source, SPORECAP_RANGE_TILES, 0), 30)
let groundA = createPreviewEnemy(1, previewRangeTile(source, SPORECAP_RANGE_TILES, 1), 20)
let groundB = createPreviewEnemy(1, previewRangeTile(source, SPORECAP_RANGE_TILES, 2), 10)
if (!air || !groundA || !groundB) return false
// Normal Wisp HP lets the nested volley visibly transition from airborne-
// first targeting to the remaining ground threats after enough spores land.
setPreviewEnemyHp(groundA, 30)
setPreviewEnemyHp(groundB, 30)
return true
}

function setupPreviewLanternleaf(source: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
let slots = previewNearbyFreeSlots(source, LANTERNLEAF_RANGE_TILES, 3)
if (slots.length < 3) return false
let sun = createPreviewDefender(farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam, slots[0].id)
let spores = createPreviewDefender(farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap, slots[1].id)
let incompatible = createPreviewDefender(farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter, slots[2].id)
if (!sun || !spores || !incompatible) return false
// Supply eight real missing units so purchased charge6 ->8 changes the
// unchanged loop's actual transfer count, rather than both previews
// being capped by an accidentally half-full/far-away recipient fixture.
sun.resource = Math.max(0, sun.resourceCap - 4)
if (spores.sporeLoaded.length < 4) return false
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) spores.sporeLoaded[i] = 0
syncSporeResource(spores)
return true
}

function setupPreviewRootsnare(source: DefenderRuntime): boolean {
let sourceSlot = slotById(source.slot)
if (!sourceSlot) return false
let reach = capturedUpgradeValue(farmWorld.progress(), farmTypes.Upgrade.SnareReach)
let mask = rootsnareMask(source, reach)
if (!mask || mask.tiles.length == 0) return false
let target = createPreviewEnemy(1, mask.tiles[0], 10)
if (!target) return false
setPreviewEnemyHp(target, 100)
previewExitEnemyId = target.id
previewExitAtMs = 2300 + (reach - 1) * 1600
previewExitTile = previewOutsideRangeTile(source, ROOTSNARE_RANGE_TILES)
return previewExitTile >= 0
}

function setupPreviewStormbloom(source: DefenderRuntime, bulbs: number, sparks: number): boolean {
let total = bulbs * sparks
if (total <= 0 || total > MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) return false
let tile = previewStormTile(source)
if (tile < 0) return false
for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
let mode = i % 6
let species = 1
if (mode == 0) species = 9
else if (mode == 2 || mode == 3) species = 6
else if (mode == 4) species = 10
else if (mode == 5) species = 12
let target = createPreviewEnemy(species, tile, total - i)
if (!target) return false
setPreviewEnemyHp(target, species == 12 ? 40 : 20)
if (mode == 2) target.shield = 2
if (mode == 3) target.shield = 0
if (mode == 4) {
target.specialActive = true
target.targetId = source.id
}
previewStormTargetIds.push(target.id)
}
return previewStormTargetIds.length == total
}

function setupPreviewScene(crop: number, pad: farmTypes.WorldObject): boolean {
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
let primary = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, upgradeIdForCrop(crop))
let secondary = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, secondaryUpgradeIdForCrop(crop))
let slot = choosePreviewSlot(crop, pad, primary, secondary)
if (!slot) return false
let source = createPreviewDefender(crop, slot.id)
if (!source) return false
previewActorId = source.id
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter) return setupPreviewSixShooter(source)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return setupPreviewTwinbud(source)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry) return true
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) return setupPreviewRage(source)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return setupPreviewPrism(source, primary)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) return setupPreviewSunbeam(source)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) return setupPreviewEcho(source, primary)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return setupPreviewHealroot(source, primary)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return setupPreviewSporecap(source)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) return setupPreviewLanternleaf(source)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return setupPreviewRootsnare(source)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return setupPreviewStormbloom(source, primary, secondary)
return false
}

function movePreviewEnemyToTile(enemy: EnemyRuntime, tile: number): void {
if (!enemy || !enemy.previewOnly || !validTile(tile)) return
enemy.visualX = tileCenterX(tile)
enemy.visualY = tileCenterY(tile)
enemy.recoveringFromKnockback = false
enemy.controlHoldMs = 0
enemy.controlSlowMs = 0
enemy.controlSlowMultiplier = 1
if (enemy.sprite) enemy.sprite.setPosition(enemy.visualX, enemy.visualY)
setEnemyTile(enemy, tile)
}

function clearPreviewScene(): void {
// Preview scenes run only outside raids. Remove only projected actors and
// their combat-owned transient effects; world placements/inventory remain
// untouched, including the A12 temporary Stormbloom projection boundary.
for (let i = mines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
if (containsNumber(previewDefenderIds, mines[i].actorId)) mines.removeAt(i)
}
for (let i = pendingEnemyHits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
if (containsNumber(previewEnemyIds, pendingEnemyHits[i].targetActorId)) pendingEnemyHits.removeAt(i)
}
for (let i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (!enemy || !enemy.previewOnly) continue
clearEnemyOccupancy(enemy)
destroyOwnedSprite(enemy.sprite)
enemies.removeAt(i)
}
for (let i = defenders.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (!defender || !defender.previewOnly) continue
destroyOwnedSprite(defender.sprite)
defenders.removeAt(i)
}
if (!raidActive) {
for (let i = 0; i < effects.length; i++) destroyOwnedSprite(effects[i].sprite)
effects = []
effectDestroyIds = []
}
previewActive = false
previewCrop = 0
previewActorId = -1
previewEnemyIds = []
previewDefenderIds = []
previewStormTargetIds = []
previewElapsedMs = 0
previewCleanupMs = -1
previewExitEnemyId = -1
previewExitAtMs = -1
previewExitTile = -1
}

function updatePreviewScenario(dtMs: number): void {
if (!previewActive) return
previewElapsedMs += dtMs
if (previewCleanupMs >= 0) {
previewCleanupMs -= dtMs
if (previewCleanupMs <= 0) clearPreviewScene()
return
}
if (previewExitEnemyId >= 0 && previewExitAtMs >= 0 && previewElapsedMs >= previewExitAtMs) {
let target = enemyById(previewExitEnemyId)
movePreviewEnemyToTile(target, previewExitTile)
previewExitEnemyId = -1
}
}

function previewStormTarget(context: farmTypes.Context): EnemyRuntime {
if (!context || context.mode != farmTypes.Mode.Preview || previewCrop != farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom || context.actorId != previewActorId) return null
let index = context.data[TD_FOCUS_COUNT]
if (index < 0 || index >= previewStormTargetIds.length) return null
let target = enemyById(previewStormTargetIds[index])
if (!target || !target.previewOnly || !validDefenderEnemyTarget(target, false)) return null
return target
}

function activeRunnerForTask(task: number): ActiveRunner {
for (let i = 0; i < activeRunners.length; i++) {
if (activeRunners[i].task == task) return activeRunners[i]
}
return null
}

function queuedCountForTask(task: number): number {
let count = 0
for (let i = 0; i < runnerQueue.length; i++) {
if (runnerQueue[i].task == task) count += 1
}
return count
}

function runnerRequestExists(task: number, actorId: number): boolean {
let active = activeRunnerForTask(task)
if (active && active.actorId == actorId) return true
for (let i = 0; i < runnerQueue.length; i++) {
if (runnerQueue[i].task == task && runnerQueue[i].actorId == actorId) return true
}
return false
}

function runnerActorValid(request: RunnerRequest): boolean {
if (!request || request.epoch != epoch || !entered) return false
if (request.mode == farmTypes.Mode.Preview) return true
let defender = defenderById(request.actorId)
return activeRootedDefender(defender) && defender.crop == request.crop
}

function removeActiveRunner(serial: number): void {
for (let i = activeRunners.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
if (activeRunners[i].serial == serial) activeRunners.removeAt(i)
}
}

function completeRunner(request: RunnerRequest, result: farmTypes.RunResult): void {
// start() reports only after the real learner callback returns. Serial and
// epoch checks keep a delayed callback from releasing/rewarding a later run.
removeActiveRunner(request.serial)
if (!entered || request.epoch != epoch) return
if (request.mode == farmTypes.Mode.Raid && request.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry && raidStage == RAID_STAGE_SETUP) {
// Completion means the learner callback actually returned. Missing/Wrong
// still completes setup honestly; an infinite callback does not.
removeNumberOnce(raidSetupWaitingActorIds, request.actorId)
}
if (request.mode == farmTypes.Mode.Raid) {
let defender = defenderById(request.actorId)
if (defender && defender.crop == request.crop) {
defender.actionMs = powerCooldownMs(request.crop)
defender.engagedEnemyId = -1
if (request.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
defender.sporeActive = false
defender.sporeNextIndex = 0
}
restoreDefenderImage(defender)
}
}
if (request.mode == farmTypes.Mode.Preview) {
// Preview is the progression/teaching boundary. Ordinary raid power
// invocations never re-award earned power progress. Missing/Wrong are
// still reported honestly; World only commits capability on Success.
if (result) farmWorld.taskResult(result)
if (previewActive && request.actorId == previewActorId && request.crop == previewCrop) {
previewCleanupMs = result && result.code == farmTypes.ResultCode.Success ? 350 : 900
}
return
}
if (!result) return
}

function startRunnerRequest(request: RunnerRequest): boolean {
if (!runnerActorValid(request)) return false
if (activeRunnerForTask(request.task) || farmProgram.busy(request.task)) return false

let context = create(request.crop, request.actorId, request.mode)
if (!context || context.cancelled) return false
context.data[CTX_RUN_SERIAL] = request.serial

let active = new ActiveRunner()
active.serial = request.serial
active.task = request.task
active.crop = request.crop
active.actorId = request.actorId
active.mode = request.mode
active.epoch = request.epoch
activeRunners.push(active)

let started = farmProgram.start(context, function(result: farmTypes.RunResult) {
completeRunner(request, result)
})
if (!started) {
removeActiveRunner(request.serial)
let defender = defenderById(request.actorId)
if (defender && request.crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) {
defender.sporeActive = false
defender.sporeNextIndex = 0
}
if (defender) defender.engagedEnemyId = -1
return false
}
return true
}

function enqueuePowerRun(crop: number, actorId: number, mode: number): boolean {
if (!entered || !validCrop(crop)) return false
if (mode != farmTypes.Mode.Raid && mode != farmTypes.Mode.Preview) return false
let task = taskForCrop(crop)
if (task <= 0 || runnerRequestExists(task, actorId)) return false
if (queuedCountForTask(task) >= MAX_SAME_TASK_QUEUE) return false

let request = new RunnerRequest()
request.serial = nextRunnerSerial++
request.task = task
request.crop = crop
request.actorId = actorId
request.mode = mode
request.epoch = epoch
if (!runnerActorValid(request)) return false

// Different species/tasks may begin together. Same-task work is queued in
// insertion order and never starts while farmProgram still reports busy.
if (!activeRunnerForTask(task) && !farmProgram.busy(task)) {
if (startRunnerRequest(request)) return true
// start() returning false while the executor is not busy means this
// request was rejected as invalid; retrying it every frame would be a
// hidden infinite scheduler loop.
if (!farmProgram.busy(task)) return false
}
runnerQueue.push(request)
return true
}

function processRunnerQueue(): void {
if (!entered || runnerQueue.length == 0) return
// Walk globally FIFO, but skip a busy species so independent species are
// not head-of-line blocked. At most one queued request per task can start.
let startedTasks: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < runnerQueue.length;) {
let request = runnerQueue[i]
if (!runnerActorValid(request)) {
runnerQueue.removeAt(i)
continue
}
if (containsNumber(startedTasks, request.task) || activeRunnerForTask(request.task) || farmProgram.busy(request.task)) {
i += 1
continue
}
if (startRunnerRequest(request)) {
startedTasks.push(request.task)
runnerQueue.removeAt(i)
} else {
i += 1
}
}
}

function upgradeIdForCrop(crop: number): number {
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.SixShooter) return farmTypes.Upgrade.Chambers
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Twinbud) return farmTypes.Upgrade.TwinCycles
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry) return farmTypes.Upgrade.TrapCount
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rage) return farmTypes.Upgrade.StartingDamage
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Prism) return farmTypes.Upgrade.MarkedTargets
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam) return farmTypes.Upgrade.Sunlight
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Echo) return farmTypes.Upgrade.PulseLevels
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Healroot) return farmTypes.Upgrade.AllyCount
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) return farmTypes.Upgrade.Charge
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Rootsnare) return farmTypes.Upgrade.SnareReach
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return farmTypes.Upgrade.Bulbs
return 0
}

function secondaryUpgradeIdForCrop(crop: number): number {
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) return farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return farmTypes.Upgrade.SparksPerBulb
return 0
}

function capturedUpgradeValue(progress: farmTypes.Progress, id: number): number {
if (id <= 0) return 0
return farmTuning.value(id, upgradeLevel(progress, id))
}

function contextCrop(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
if (!context || context.data.length <= CTX_CROP) return 0
return context.data[CTX_CROP]
}

function contextPrimaryValue(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
if (!context || context.data.length <= CTX_PRIMARY_VALUE) return 0
return context.data[CTX_PRIMARY_VALUE]
}

function contextSecondaryValue(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
if (!context || context.data.length <= CTX_SECONDARY_VALUE) return 0
return context.data[CTX_SECONDARY_VALUE]
}

function contextResourceStart(context: farmTypes.Context): number {
if (!context || context.data.length <= CTX_RESOURCE_START) return 0
return context.data[CTX_RESOURCE_START]
}

function initializePowerTaskData(context: farmTypes.Context): void {
if (!context) return
while (context.data.length <= TD_ROOT_PATCH_ORIGIN) context.data.push(0)
context.data[TD_COUNT_A] = 0
context.data[TD_COUNT_B] = 0
context.data[TD_INVALID] = 0
context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] = 0
context.data[TD_TARGET_ID] = -1
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X] = 0
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y] = 0
context.data[TD_ALT_TARGET_ID] = -1
context.data[TD_ALT_AIM_X] = 0
context.data[TD_ALT_AIM_Y] = 0
context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] = 0
context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] = 0
context.data[TD_MINES_ARMED] = 0
context.data[TD_SEQUENCE_ERROR] = 0
context.data[TD_SNAPSHOT_COUNT] = 0
context.data[TD_EXPECTED_BRANCH] = -1
context.data[TD_BRANCH_HANDLED] = 1
context.data[TD_RESOURCE_USED] = 0
context.data[TD_ECHO_LAST_RADIUS] = 0
context.data[TD_HEAL_ATTEMPTS] = 0
context.data[TD_HEAL_GOOD] = 0
context.data[TD_INSPECT_EXPECTED] = -1
context.data[TD_GROUP_TOTAL] = 0
context.data[TD_GROUP_USED] = 0
context.data[TD_TRANSFER_GOOD] = 0
context.data[TD_TRANSFER_RETURNED] = 0
context.data[TD_ROOT_LAST_REACH] = 0
context.data[TD_STORM_SPARKS_USED] = 0
context.data[TD_FOCUS_COUNT] = 0
context.data[TD_ROOT_PATCH_ORIGIN] = -1
context.cursor = 0
context.group = -1

if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Prism) buildPrismSnapshot(context, defenderById(context.actorId))
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Healroot) buildHealrootSnapshot(context, defenderById(context.actorId))

if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Sporecap) {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
if (defender) {
defender.sporeActive = true
defender.sporeNextIndex = 0
}
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rootsnare) {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
let target = chooseRootsnareTarget(defender)
if (target) {
context.data[TD_TARGET_ID] = target.id
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X] = target.visualX
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y] = target.visualY
context.data[TD_ROOT_PATCH_ORIGIN] = target.tile
if (defender) defender.engagedEnemyId = target.id
}
}

if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rage) {
let defender = defenderById(context.actorId)
let target = chooseThreatEnemyForDefender(defender, true, -1, RAGE_RANGE_TILES)
if (target) {
context.data[TD_TARGET_ID] = target.id
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_X] = target.visualX
context.data[TD_LAST_AIM_Y] = target.visualY
if (defender) defender.engagedEnemyId = target.id
}
}
}

function operationAllowed(context: farmTypes.Context, operationId: number, value: number): boolean {
// farmProgram owns the opaque token, operation allow-list, ops budget and
// cancellation flag. Combat defensively verifies only its domain/lifecycle
// state before mutating world state. Do not duplicate executor authority.
if (!contextIsCurrent(context)) {
staleContext(context, operationId, value)
return false
}
// A defender that wilts during its currently running learner callback is
// inactive immediately. The native fiber may still return later, but no
// later read/test/action from that raid context may mutate combat state.
if (context.mode == farmTypes.Mode.Raid) {
