```customts
function earliestScheduledSpawnIndex(): number {
if (raidScheduledSpawns.length < 1) return -1
let best = 0
for (let i = 1; i < raidScheduledSpawns.length; i++) {
let candidate = raidScheduledSpawns[i]
let current = raidScheduledSpawns[best]
if (candidate.dueMs < current.dueMs) best = i
}
return best
}

function emitRaidSpawn(request: SpawnRequest): boolean {
if (!request || request.routeId < 0) return false
return spawnEnemy(request.enemySpecies, request.routeId, request.generation) != null
}

function drainBlockedRaidSpawns(): void {
while (blockedSpawns.length > 0 && aliveEnemyCount() < MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) {
let request = blockedSpawns[0]
if (!emitRaidSpawn(request)) return
blockedSpawns.removeAt(0)
}
}

function emitDueRaidSpawns(): void {
// Once a cap-blocked parent exists, later scheduled identities remain in the
// phase schedule until FIFO backpressure drains. This prevents overtaking and
// means no required enemy identity is silently discarded.
if (blockedSpawns.length > 0) return
while (raidScheduledSpawns.length > 0) {
let index = earliestScheduledSpawnIndex()
if (index < 0) return
let request = raidScheduledSpawns[index]
if (request.dueMs > raidPhaseElapsedMs) return
if (aliveEnemyCount() >= MAX_LIVE_ENEMIES) {
if (blockedSpawns.length < MAX_BLOCKED_SPAWNS) {
raidScheduledSpawns.removeAt(index)
blockedSpawns.push(request)
}
return
}
raidScheduledSpawns.removeAt(index)
if (!emitRaidSpawn(request)) {
// With valid authored routes the only ordinary failure is cap pressure;
// retain the request rather than deleting a wave identity.
if (blockedSpawns.length < MAX_BLOCKED_SPAWNS) blockedSpawns.push(request)
return
}
}
}

function raidPhaseResolved(): boolean {
return raidScheduledSpawns.length == 0 && blockedSpawns.length == 0 && pendingChildren.length == 0 && aliveEnemyCount() == 0
}

function beginRaidCountdown(): void {
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_SETUP) return
// Mineberry setup consequences (armed mines) persist, but all defender HP
// and physical stores begin the actual battle full. Player HP is World-owned
// and is restored by World before beginRaid under the shared lifecycle.
restoreRaidDefenders()
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_COUNTDOWN
raidCountdownRemainingMs = RAID_COUNTDOWN_MS
raidCountdownShown = 3
farmWorld.notice("Raid starts in 3...")
}

function beginRaidWavePhase(phase: number): boolean {
if (phase < 0 || phase >= raidPhaseCount(raidArea)) return false
blockedSpawns = []
raidPhaseIndex = phase
if (!buildRaidPhaseSchedule(raidArea, phase)) return false
farmWorld.notice("Wave " + (phase + 1) + " of " + raidPhaseCount(raidArea))
return true
}

function beginRaidActive(): void {
if (!raidActive) return
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_ACTIVE
raidCountdownRemainingMs = 0
raidCountdownShown = -1
if (!beginRaidWavePhase(0)) settleRaid(false)
}

function beginRaidSetup(): void {
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_SETUP
raidSetupWaitingActorIds = []
// Every rooted Mineberry executes the student's CURRENT callback once before
// countdown. Missing/Wrong returns simply leave an incomplete trap field;
// only a callback that never returns keeps this setup stage occupied.
for (let i = 0; i < defenders.length; i++) {
let defender = defenders[i]
if (!activeRootedDefender(defender) || defender.crop != farmTypes.Crop.Mineberry) continue
raidSetupWaitingActorIds.push(defender.id)
if (!enqueuePowerRun(defender.crop, defender.id, farmTypes.Mode.Raid)) removeNumberOnce(raidSetupWaitingActorIds, defender.id)
}
if (raidSetupWaitingActorIds.length == 0) beginRaidCountdown()
}

function clearRaidBattleTransient(): void {
farmProgram.cancelAll()
for (let i = 0; i < effects.length; i++) destroyOwnedSprite(effects[i].sprite)
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) destroyOwnedSprite(enemies[i].sprite)
effects = []
enemies = []
occupancy = []
pendingEnemyHits = []
mines = []
blockedSpawns = []
pendingChildren = []
raidScheduledSpawns = []
raidSetupWaitingActorIds = []
enemyDestroyIds = []
effectDestroyIds = []
runnerQueue = []
activeRunners = []
}

function settleRaid(success: boolean): void {
if (!raidActive || raidResultSent) return
let finishingArea = raidArea
let finishingEpoch = epoch
raidResultSent = true
raidSettled = true
raidActive = false
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_SETTLED
clearRaidBattleTransient()

// This is the only durable raid-result call owned by Combat. World commits
// successful rooting/progression or restores its pre-raid snapshot on false.
farmWorld.raidFinished(success)

// raidFinished is synchronous in the service contract. Rebuild transient
// defenders from World's post-result authority so success revives rooted
// plants and failure visibly restores adjustable pre-Ready placements.
if (entered && currentArea == finishingArea && epoch == finishingEpoch) rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
}

function updateRaidSetup(): void {
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_SETUP) return
if (farmTasks.livingCropCount() <= 0) {
settleRaid(false)
return
}
if (raidSetupWaitingActorIds.length == 0) beginRaidCountdown()
}

function updateRaidCountdown(dtMs: number): void {
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_COUNTDOWN) return
if (farmTasks.livingCropCount() <= 0) {
settleRaid(false)
return
}
raidCountdownRemainingMs -= dtMs
if (raidCountdownRemainingMs <= 0) {
beginRaidActive()
return
}
let second = Math.ceil(raidCountdownRemainingMs / 1000)
if (second < raidCountdownShown && second > 0) {
raidCountdownShown = second
farmWorld.notice("Raid starts in " + second + "...")
}
}

function updateRaidActive(dtMs: number): void {
if (!raidActive || raidStage != RAID_STAGE_ACTIVE) return
if (farmTasks.livingCropCount() <= 0) {
settleRaid(false)
return
}

// Splitter children are given first chance at newly opened cap slots by the
// main update loop. Then drain any previously blocked scheduled parent. While
// a parent remains cap-blocked, freeze this phase's emission clock rather
// than compressing all later timing into a burst.
drainBlockedRaidSpawns()
if (blockedSpawns.length > 0) return
raidPhaseElapsedMs += dtMs
emitDueRaidSpawns()

if (!raidPhaseResolved()) return
let nextPhase = raidPhaseIndex + 1
if (nextPhase < raidPhaseCount(raidArea)) {
beginRaidWavePhase(nextPhase)
return
}

// All schedulable identities/queued children are resolved here. Player HP
// and crop objectives are both authoritative read-only checks.
if (farmWorld.playerHealth() <= 0) settleRaid(false)
else if (farmTasks.livingCropCount() > 0) settleRaid(true)
else settleRaid(false)
}

function updateRaidLifecycle(dtMs: number): void {
if (!raidActive) return
// raidFinished(false) may synchronously restore HP through World rollback, so
// return immediately after settlement and never reinterpret that restoration
// as revival of the same attempt.
if (farmWorld.playerHealth() <= 0) {
settleRaid(false)
return
}
if (raidStage == RAID_STAGE_SETUP) updateRaidSetup()
else if (raidStage == RAID_STAGE_COUNTDOWN) updateRaidCountdown(dtMs)
else if (raidStage == RAID_STAGE_ACTIVE) updateRaidActive(dtMs)
}

// ---- Cross-package farmCombat service ----

export function enter(area: number): void {
if (!validArea(area)) return

// enter() is idempotent for the same live area. A changed area always gets
// a new epoch so delayed fibers/effects cannot mutate the new scene.
if (entered && currentArea == area) return
if (entered) hardCleanup()

epoch += 1
entered = true
currentArea = area
elapsedMs = 0
clearRaidState()
clearRuntimeCollections()
playerAttackCooldownMs = 0
playerInvulnerableMs = 0
playerFacingX = 0
playerFacingY = 1
activeLayout = farmWorld.layout()
buildRouteCache(activeLayout)
buildEnemyReachLookups()

// Durable placement authority remains in World. Combat rebuilds only
// transient sprites/HP/resources for placements in the active area.
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
// Entering an area never creates enemies by itself. The raid stage machine
// below is the only scheduler that emits required wave enemies.
}

export function leave(): void {
if (!entered) return
hardCleanup()
entered = false
currentArea = 0
}

export function update(dtMs: number): void {
if (!entered) return
let dt = clampDt(dtMs)
elapsedMs += dt
if (raidActive) raidElapsedMs += dt
if (playerAttackCooldownMs > 0) playerAttackCooldownMs = Math.max(0, playerAttackCooldownMs - dt)
if (playerInvulnerableMs > 0) playerInvulnerableMs = Math.max(0, playerInvulnerableMs - dt)
updatePlayerFacing()
updatePreviewScenario(dt)

// Advanced route enemies establish/maintain their bounded firing/siphon
// stances before movement. Phase Mite toggles targetability here but keeps
// ordinary route movement/contact/crop biting in both states.
updateAdvancedEnemyStances(dt)
updateEnemyControlTimers(dt)

// Ground actors advance only on their authored route. Sky Wisp direct
// flight is the sole route exception and still maintains currentTile.
updateEnemyMovement(dt)
updateEnemyStates(dt)
updateEnergyRecharge(dt)
updateDefenderPowerTriggers(dt)
updateMines()
updatePlayerContactDamage()
updateCommittedEnemyHits(dt)
updateEffects(dt)
flushDeferred()
// Splitter children are emitted only after the parent killing event has
// completed and deferred parent removal has flushed. Population cap delays
// rather than discards pending children.
processPendingChildren()
flushDeferred()
processRunnerQueue()
updateRaidLifecycle(dt)
}

export function interact(object: farmTypes.WorldObject): boolean {
if (!entered || !object) return false
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.DefenderSlot) {
// ART_CONTRACT: DefenderSlot.arg is the authored D-slot id.
return interactDefenderSlot(object.arg)
}
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.PracticePad) {
// ART_CONTRACT: arg is the required crop id; arg2==1 is reserved for
// the temporary Stormbloom projection. The projection still uses the
// same preview service and never becomes inventory/placement.
if (!validCrop(object.arg)) return false
if (object.arg2 == 1 && object.arg != farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom) return false
if (!preview(object.arg)) {
// The pad was still the handled world object even when practice is
// temporarily unavailable (busy runner/layout issue).
return true
}
return true
}
return false
}

export function attack(): void {
if (!entered || playerAttackCooldownMs > 0) return
let player = farmWorld.player()
if (!player) return
updatePlayerFacing()

let weapon = equippedOwnedWeapon()
let reach = weaponReachPx(weapon)
let damage = weaponDamage(weapon)
let knockback = weaponKnockbackPx(weapon)

// A B press is one bounded swing event. Processing the bounded enemy list
// once guarantees at most one hit per enemy per swing without a hit cache.
for (let i = 0; i < enemies.length; i++) {
let enemy = enemies[i]
if (!enemyInsidePlayerSwing(enemy, player, reach)) continue
applyEnemyEffect(enemy, damage, DAMAGE_ORDINARY, false, knockback, player.x, player.y)
}
showWeaponSwing(player, weapon)
playerAttackCooldownMs = weaponCooldownMs(weapon)
}

export function beginRaid(area: number): boolean {
if (!entered || area != currentArea || area < 1 || area > 12) return false
if (raidActive) return false
if (previewActive || anyCombatRunnerBusy()) {
farmWorld.notice("Finish the current learner routine before the raid.")
return false
}
if (!activeLayout || activeRoutes.length < 1 || raidPhaseCount(area) < 1) {
farmWorld.notice("This area's raid layout is incomplete.")
return false
}
if (!allRouteCropPrioritiesValid()) {
farmWorld.notice("This area's raid routes need authored crop priorities.")
return false
}

// World must already have saved the adjustable pre-raid setup and entered
// Phase.Raid. Combat locks transient battle actors; permanent rooting is
// exclusively World's successful-raid commit.
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!raidWorldCommitted(progress, area) || !allAreaPlacementsValid(progress, area) || (area > 1 && placementCount(progress, area) < 1)) {
farmWorld.notice("Raid setup has not been committed yet.")
return false
}

// Rebuild temporary battle actors from the committed placement snapshot
// and current purchased physical capacities without changing World data.
rebuildDefendersFromWorld()
raidActive = true
raidSettled = false
raidResultSent = false
raidArea = area
raidElapsedMs = 0
raidPhaseIndex = 0
raidPhaseElapsedMs = 0
raidScheduledSpawns = []
blockedSpawns = []
pendingChildren = []
raidInitialCropCount = farmTasks.livingCropCount()

// Empty objectives or an already-dead World-owned player are real soft
// failures, not successful empty attempts. livingCropCount above also
// performs Farming's required raid-objective synchronization before any
// individual cropAlive queries occur during spawning/biting.
if (raidInitialCropCount <= 0 || farmWorld.playerHealth() <= 0) {
raidStage = RAID_STAGE_SETUP
settleRaid(false)
return true
}

beginRaidSetup()
return true
}

export function create(crop: number, actorId: number, mode: number): farmTypes.Context {
let context = new farmTypes.Context()
if (!entered || !validCrop(crop)) {
context.cancelled = true
return context
}
if (mode != farmTypes.Mode.Raid && mode != farmTypes.Mode.Preview) {
context.cancelled = true
return context
}
if (mode == farmTypes.Mode.Raid) {
let actor = defenderById(actorId)
if (!activeRootedDefender(actor) || actor.crop != crop) {
context.cancelled = true
return context
}
}

let progress = farmWorld.progress()
let primaryUpgrade = upgradeIdForCrop(crop)
let secondaryUpgrade = secondaryUpgradeIdForCrop(crop)
let primaryValue = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, primaryUpgrade)
let secondaryValue = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, secondaryUpgrade)
let resourceStart = contextActorResource(crop, actorId, primaryValue, secondaryValue)
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) {
let source = defenderById(actorId)
if (source) resourceStart = Math.min(resourceStart, totalCompatibleMissingEnergy(source))
}
let resourceCap = resourceStart
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sunbeam || crop == farmTypes.Crop.Lanternleaf) resourceCap = primaryValue
else if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Sporecap) resourceCap = primaryValue * secondaryValue

context.task = taskForCrop(crop)
context.area = currentArea
context.mode = mode
context.actorId = actorId
context.resource = resourceStart
context.cursor = -1
context.group = -1
context.data.push(epoch)
context.data.push(crop)
context.data.push(primaryValue)
context.data.push(secondaryValue)
context.data.push(resourceStart)
context.data.push(resourceCap)
context.data.push(0) // run serial is filled by startRunnerRequest()
initializePowerTaskData(context)
return context
}

export function action(context: farmTypes.Context, action: number, value: number): void {
if (!operationAllowed(context, action, value)) return
if (!actionAllowedForTask(context.task, action)) {
appendTrace(context, action, value, OUT_INVALID_VALUE)
pause(1)
return
}
let outcome = performPowerPrimitive(context, action, value)
appendTrace(context, action, value, outcome)
// Every learner primitive is one bounded world job and yields before the
// wrapper returns. This keeps intended while loops cooperative without
// moving repetition into supplied code.
pause(1)
}

export function read(context: farmTypes.Context, reader: number): number {
if (!operationAllowed(context, reader, 0)) return 0
if (!readerAllowedForTask(context.task, reader)) {
appendTrace(context, reader, 0, OUT_INVALID_VALUE)
pause(1)
return 0
}
let value = readCapturedValue(context, reader)
appendTrace(context, reader, value, OUT_APPLIED)
pause(1)
return value
}

export function test(context: farmTypes.Context, predicate: number, value: number): boolean {
if (!operationAllowed(context, predicate, value)) return false
if (!predicateAllowedForTask(context.task, predicate)) {
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, OUT_INVALID_VALUE)
pause(1)
return false
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rage && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.EnemyNearby) {
let answer = rageEnemyNearby(context)
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, answer ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_STALE_TARGET)
pause(1)
return answer
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Prism && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Armored) {
let answer = prismArmored(context)
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, answer ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_WRONG_BRANCH_VISIBLE)
pause(1)
return answer
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Healroot && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.DamagedAlly) {
let answer = healrootDamagedAlly(context)
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, answer ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_HEALTHY_NOOP)
pause(1)
return answer
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Rootsnare && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Trapped) {
let outcome = rootsnarePredicateOutcome(context, value)
let answer = outcome == OUT_APPLIED
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, outcome)
pause(1)
return answer
}
if (context.task == farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom && predicate == farmTypes.Predicate.Conductive) {
let target = enemyById(context.data[TD_TARGET_ID])
let valid = target != null && validDefenderEnemyTarget(target, false) && context.data[TD_LAST_ACTION] == farmTypes.Action.Focus
let answer = valid && stormConductive(context)
if (answer) context.data[TD_PRED_TRUE] += 1
else context.data[TD_PRED_FALSE] += 1
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, valid ? OUT_APPLIED : OUT_NO_CURRENT_TARGET)
pause(1)
return answer
}
appendTrace(context, predicate, value, OUT_INVALID_VALUE)
pause(1)
return false
}

export function finish(context: farmTypes.Context): farmTypes.RunResult {
if (!context) return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Cancelled, "missing combat context")
if (context.cancelled || !contextIsCurrent(context)) {
return makeResult(context, farmTypes.ResultCode.Cancelled, "combat context cancelled")
}
return evaluatePowerContext(context)
}

export function ready(area: number): boolean {
if (!entered || area != currentArea || area < 1 || area > 12) return false
if (raidActive) {
farmWorld.notice("A raid is already active.")
return false
}
if (previewActive || anyCombatRunnerBusy()) {
farmWorld.notice("Finish the current learner routine before Ready.")
return false
}
let progress = farmWorld.progress()
if (!isPrepPhase(progress, area)) {
farmWorld.notice("Finish this area's farm work before Ready.")
return false
}
if (!allRouteCropPrioritiesValid()) {
farmWorld.notice("This area's raid routes need authored crop priorities.")
return false
}

// A1 is intentionally player-only. farmTasks.ready owns its farm routine;
// Combat contributes no defender requirement.
if (area == 1) return true

let cap = defenderCapForArea(area)
if (placementCount(progress, area) > cap) {
farmWorld.notice("Too many defenders are staged for this area.")
return false
}

let requiredCrop = requiredDefenderCrop(area)
if (!powerEarned(progress, requiredCrop)) {
farmWorld.notice("Program " + cropDisplayName(requiredCrop) + " before Ready.")
return false
}
if (placementCropCount(progress, area, requiredCrop) < 1) {
farmWorld.notice("Stage at least one " + cropDisplayName(requiredCrop) + ".")
return false
}

// A11 requires Lanternleaf plus an actual compatible energy-bearing ally.
// Only Sunbeam and Sporecap satisfy the companion requirement.
if (area == 11 && !compatibleEnergyCompanionPresent(progress, area)) {
farmWorld.notice("Stage Sunbeam or Sporecap with Lanternleaf.")
return false
}

// A12 uses Rootsnare in the raid, but the temporary Stormbloom projection
// must have completed successfully first. World owns the earned flag.
if (area == 12 && !powerEarned(progress, farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom)) {
farmWorld.notice("Complete Stormbloom practice before Ready.")
return false
}
return true
}

export function preview(crop: number): boolean {
if (!entered || !validCrop(crop) || !activeLayout) return false
if (raidActive) {
farmWorld.notice("Power practice is unavailable during a raid.")
return false
}
if (previewActive) {
farmWorld.notice("Power practice is already running.")
return false
}
if (activeRunners.length > 0 || runnerQueue.length > 0 || farmProgram.busy(taskForCrop(crop))) {
farmWorld.notice("Finish the current learner routine first.")
return false
}

previewActive = true
previewCrop = crop
previewActorId = -1
previewEnemyIds = []
previewDefenderIds = []
previewStormTargetIds = []
previewElapsedMs = 0
previewCleanupMs = -1
previewExitEnemyId = -1
previewExitAtMs = -1
previewExitTile = -1

let pad = practicePadForCrop(crop)
if (!setupPreviewScene(crop, pad) || previewActorId < 0) {
clearPreviewScene()
farmWorld.notice("This area's practice layout is incomplete.")
return false
}

let progress = farmWorld.progress()
let primary = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, upgradeIdForCrop(crop))
let secondary = capturedUpgradeValue(progress, secondaryUpgradeIdForCrop(crop))
farmWorld.notice(previewAnatomyMessage(crop, primary, secondary))

// This always invokes the student's currently registered callback. Missing
// code returns Missing through farmProgram; wrong code leaves its visible
// physical consequences and evaluates Wrong. No accepted trace is cached or
// substituted on later practice/raid invocations.
if (!enqueuePowerRun(crop, previewActorId, farmTypes.Mode.Preview)) {
clearPreviewScene()
farmWorld.notice("Could not start power practice.")
return false
}
return true
}
}

const STARTING_GOLD = 0

// player Sprite and immutable layout data, never these kind numbers.
const PLAYER_KIND = SpriteKind.create()
const WORLD_OBJECT_KIND = SpriteKind.create()

let currentProgress: farmTypes.Progress = null
let currentPlayer: Sprite = null

// competing gameplay controls.

// Step 7: task completion reports are transient runtime evidence. Program
// owns invocation tokens; World remembers only the newest report observed
// for each learner task during this runtime so duplicate/stale reports
// cannot re-award durable progression. Tokens are intentionally not saved:
// a new simulator/runtime starts a new program execution epoch.
let lastResultTokenByTask: number[] = []

// Step 8: World owns the durable raid transaction. Combat owns only the
// transient battle. These recovery values are runtime mirrors of the
// pre-raid save snapshot so failure can restore exact PREP state without
// asking Combat to reconstruct inventory/placements/farming state.
let activeRaidArea = 0
let raidRecoveryProgress: farmTypes.Progress = null
let raidRecoveryFarm: number[] = []

// Step 9: one world-owned active-play/update clock and one safe scene
// transition gate. A transition first cancels learner contexts, then waits
// until every registered learner execution slot has actually returned.
// Only then may the old domain scene be left/reused.
let lastUpdateMs = 0
let lastPeriodicCheckpointClock = 0
let pendingTransitionArea = -1
let pendingTransitionEntryObjectId = -1
let pendingTransitionReason = ""
let pendingTransitionStartedMs = 0
let pendingTransitionRecoveryShown = false

// Step 2: world-owned durable progress authority. All public reads return a
// deep snapshot; callers never receive the mutable authority object.
function zeroArray(length: number): number[] {
let result: number[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) result.push(0)
return result
}

function freshProgress(): farmTypes.Progress {
let p = new farmTypes.Progress()
p.gold = STARTING_GOLD
p.area = 1
p.weapon = farmTypes.Weapon.GardenBlade
p.weapons = [1, 0, 0]
p.playedMs = 0
p.complete = false

p.unlocked = zeroArray(13)
p.cleared = zeroArray(13)
p.phase = zeroArray(13)
p.inventory = zeroArray(13)
p.expansion = zeroArray(13)
p.farmEarned = zeroArray(14)
p.upgrades = zeroArray(15)
p.powerEarned = zeroArray(13)
p.placements = []

// A1 is the free starting area. Index zero remains reserved.
p.unlocked[1] = 1
p.phase[1] = farmTypes.Phase.Farm
return p
}

function clonePlacement(source: farmTypes.Placement): farmTypes.Placement {
let copy = new farmTypes.Placement()
copy.area = source.area
copy.slot = source.slot
copy.crop = source.crop
copy.rooted = source.rooted
return copy
}

function cloneNumberArray(source: number[]): number[] {
let copy: number[] = []
if (!source) return copy
for (let i = 0; i < source.length; i++) copy.push(source[i])
return copy
}

function clearRaidRecovery(): void {
activeRaidArea = 0
raidRecoveryProgress = null
raidRecoveryFarm = []
}

function cloneProgress(source: farmTypes.Progress): farmTypes.Progress {
if (!source) return null
let copy = new farmTypes.Progress()
copy.gold = source.gold
copy.area = source.area
copy.weapon = source.weapon
copy.weapons = cloneNumberArray(source.weapons)
copy.playedMs = source.playedMs
copy.complete = source.complete
copy.unlocked = cloneNumberArray(source.unlocked)
copy.cleared = cloneNumberArray(source.cleared)
copy.phase = cloneNumberArray(source.phase)
copy.inventory = cloneNumberArray(source.inventory)
copy.expansion = cloneNumberArray(source.expansion)
copy.farmEarned = cloneNumberArray(source.farmEarned)
copy.upgrades = cloneNumberArray(source.upgrades)
copy.powerEarned = cloneNumberArray(source.powerEarned)
copy.placements = []
if (source.placements) {
for (let i = 0; i < source.placements.length; i++) {
copy.placements.push(clonePlacement(source.placements[i]))
}
}
return copy
}

function ensureProgress(): boolean {
if (currentProgress) return true
if (!started) return false
currentProgress = freshProgress()
return true
}

function findPlacementIndex(area: number, slot: number): number {
if (!currentProgress || !currentProgress.placements) return -1
for (let i = 0; i < currentProgress.placements.length; i++) {
let p = currentProgress.placements[i]
if (p.area == area && p.slot == slot) return i
}
return -1
}

// Step-1 private economy helpers. These are deliberately not cross-package API.
function validArea(area: number): boolean {
return area >= 1 && area <= 12
}

function validCrop(crop: number): boolean {
return crop >= 1 && crop <= 12
}

function validWeapon(weapon: number): boolean {
return weapon >= 0 && weapon <= 2
}

function validDestination(area: number): boolean {
return area >= 0 && area <= 12
}

function areaName(area: number): string {
return area >= 0 && area < AREA_NAME.length ? AREA_NAME[area] : "AREA"
}

function cropName(crop: number): string {
return validCrop(crop) ? CROP_NAME[crop] : "CROP"
}

function areaUnlockCost(area: number): number {
if (!validArea(area)) return 0
return AREA_UNLOCK_COST[area]
}

function cropSellValue(crop: number): number {
if (!validCrop(crop)) return 0
return CROP_SELL_VALUE[crop]
}

function cropRegrowMs(crop: number): number {
if (!validCrop(crop)) return 0
return CROP_REGROW_MS[crop]
}

function expansionPrice(area: number, nextTier: number): number {
if (!validArea(area)) return 0
if (nextTier == 1) return EXPANSION_PRICE_TIER1[area]
if (nextTier == 2) return EXPANSION_PRICE_TIER2[area]
return 0
}

function expansionProduction(area: number, tier: number): number {
if (!validArea(area)) return 0
let total = AREA_BASE_PRODUCTION[area]
if (tier >= 1) total += EXPANSION_ADD_TIER1[area]
if (tier >= 2) total += EXPANSION_ADD_TIER2[area]
return total
}

function weaponPrice(weapon: number): number {
if (!validWeapon(weapon)) return 0
return WEAPON_PRICE[weapon]
}

function validLearnerTask(task: number): boolean {
return (task >= farmTypes.Task.Plant && task <= farmTypes.Task.Grove)
|| (task >= farmTypes.Task.SixShooter && task <= farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom)
}

function farmTaskArea(task: number): number {
if (task == farmTypes.Task.Plant || task == farmTypes.Task.Water) return 1
if (task >= farmTypes.Task.Trellis && task <= farmTypes.Task.Grove) return task - 1
return 0
}

function powerCrop(task: number): number {
if (task < farmTypes.Task.SixShooter || task > farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom) return 0
return task - 100
}

function powerPracticeArea(crop: number): number {
if (!validCrop(crop)) return 0
// Each earned crop power is first required during the following area's
// preparation. Stormbloom is the explicit A12 projection exception.
return crop < farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom ? crop + 1 : 12
}

function farmRequirementsEarned(area: number): boolean {
if (!currentProgress || !validArea(area)) return false
if (area == 1) {
return currentProgress.farmEarned[farmTypes.Task.Plant] > 0
&& currentProgress.farmEarned[farmTypes.Task.Water] > 0
}
let task = area + 1
return task >= farmTypes.Task.Trellis
&& task <= farmTypes.Task.Grove
&& currentProgress.farmEarned[task] > 0
}

function ensureResultTokenTable(): void {
if (lastResultTokenByTask.length >= 113) return
lastResultTokenByTask = zeroArray(113)
}

function acceptFreshResultToken(task: number, token: number): boolean {
if (!validLearnerTask(task) || token <= 0 || token != Math.floor(token)) return false
ensureResultTokenTable()
if (token <= lastResultTokenByTask[task]) return false
lastResultTokenByTask[task] = token
return true
}

function resultFeedback(result: farmTypes.RunResult): void {
if (!result || !result.message) return
// Domain-authored result messages describe the observed current-code
// outcome. They are feedback only and never become a progression award.
notice(result.message)
}

// Required MF-CONTRACT-1.0 farmWorld service surface. Later steps replace
// the conservative scaffold bodies without changing these signatures.
function hasRaidPhase(progress: farmTypes.Progress): boolean {
if (!progress || !progress.phase) return false
for (let area = 1; area <= 12; area++) if (progress.phase[area] == farmTypes.Phase.Raid) return true
return false
}

function tryLoadSnapshot(snapshot: farmSave.Snapshot): boolean {
if (!snapshot || !snapshot.progress) return false
// Package 02 validates its entire opaque payload before mutating. Only
// after that succeeds do we replace world Progress authority.
if (!farmTasks.importState(snapshot.farm)) return false
currentProgress = cloneProgress(snapshot.progress)
return true
}

function candidateNeedsRaidRecovery(candidate: farmSave.Candidate): boolean {
return !!candidate && !!candidate.recovery && hasRaidPhase(candidate.current.progress)
}

function candidateSnapshot(candidate: farmSave.Candidate): farmSave.Snapshot {
if (!candidate) return null
// A save made after RAID phase was entered must reload to the stable
// pre-raid recovery snapshot, never to transient combat progress.
if (candidateNeedsRaidRecovery(candidate)) return candidate.recovery
return candidate.current
}

function layoutAreaValid(area: number): boolean {
return area >= 0 && area <= 12
}

function validLayout(source: farmTypes.Layout, expectedArea: number): boolean {
if (!source || source.area != expectedArea) return false
if (source.width <= 0 || source.height <= 0) return false
if (source.width > MAX_LAYOUT_TILES || source.height > MAX_LAYOUT_TILES) return false
if (source.width != Math.floor(source.width) || source.height != Math.floor(source.height)) return false
let count = source.width * source.height
if (!source.ground || source.ground.length != count) return false
if (!source.walls || source.walls.length != count) return false
if (!source.entry) return false
if (source.entry.x < 0 || source.entry.y < 0) return false
if (source.entry.x >= source.width * TILE_SIZE || source.entry.y >= source.height * TILE_SIZE) return false
for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
let ground = source.ground[i]
if (ground < 1 || ground >= GROUND_TILE_KEY.length || ground != Math.floor(ground)) return false
let wall = source.walls[i]
if (wall != 0 && wall != 1) return false
}
if (!source.objects || !source.cropTiles || !source.defenderSlots || !source.routes || !source.masks) return false
for (let i = 0; i < source.objects.length; i++) {
let object = source.objects[i]
if (!object) return false
if (object.x < 0 || object.y < 0 || object.x >= source.width * TILE_SIZE || object.y >= source.height * TILE_SIZE) return false
if (object.kind < farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit || object.kind > farmTypes.ObjectKind.Reset) return false
for (let j = 0; j < i; j++) if (source.objects[j].id == object.id) return false
}
return true
}

function clearWorldObjectSprites(): void {
for (let i = 0; i < worldObjectSprites.length; i++) {
if (worldObjectSprites[i]) worldObjectSprites[i].destroy()
}
worldObjectSprites = []
}

function clearRegion(): void {
if (currentLayout) {
farmTasks.leave()
farmCombat.leave()
}
clearWorldObjectSprites()
currentLayout = null
}

function tileImage(tileId: number): Image {
if (tileId <= 0 || tileId >= GROUND_TILE_KEY.length) return null
return farmArt.frame(GROUND_TILE_KEY[tileId], 0)
}

function renderGround(source: farmTypes.Layout): void {
// MF-CONTRACT-1.0's canonical integration manifest depends only on
// `device`, so build a modern Arcade TileMapData directly instead of
// depending on the optional legacy color-coded-tilemap package.
// TileMapData stores UInt16LE width/height in the first four bytes, then
// one tileset index per authored map cell.
let count = source.width * source.height
let data = control.createBuffer(4 + count)
data.setNumber(NumberFormat.UInt16LE, 0, source.width)
data.setNumber(NumberFormat.UInt16LE, 2, source.height)

// Keep explicit indices so the authored numeric ground IDs remain stable.
let tileset: Image[] = []
for (let tileId = 0; tileId <= COLLISION_TILE_ID; tileId++) {
let tile: Image = null
if (tileId == BARRIER_TILE_ID) tile = farmArt.frame("object.barrier.closed", 0)
else if (tileId == COLLISION_TILE_ID) tile = farmArt.frame("tile.wall", 0)
else tile = tileImage(tileId)
if (!tile) tile = image.create(TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE)
tileset.push(tile)
}

for (let y = 0; y < source.height; y++) {
for (let x = 0; x < source.width; x++) {
let index = y * source.width + x
let tileId = source.walls[index] ? COLLISION_TILE_ID : source.ground[index]
data.setUint8(4 + index, tileId)
}
}

// A locked Barrier is a real physical blocker. Its authored tile is
// temporarily replaced by one dedicated tile; purchasing the area
// rerenders the same immutable Layout without that blocker.
if (source.objects && currentProgress) {
for (let i = 0; i < source.objects.length; i++) {
let object = source.objects[i]
if (object.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Barrier) continue
if (!validArea(object.arg) || currentProgress.unlocked[object.arg]) continue
let bx = Math.floor(object.x / TILE_SIZE)
let by = Math.floor(object.y / TILE_SIZE)
if (bx >= 0 && bx < source.width && by >= 0 && by < source.height) {
data.setUint8(4 + by * source.width + bx, BARRIER_TILE_ID)
}
}
}

// The wall layer starts empty. Use the public tiles wall API after the
// map is active rather than depending on TileMapData's private wall-bit
// encoding.
let wallLayer = image.create(source.width, source.height)
tiles.setCurrentTilemap(tiles.createTilemap(data, wallLayer, tileset, TileScale.Sixteen))

for (let y = 0; y < source.height; y++) {
for (let x = 0; x < source.width; x++) {
let index = y * source.width + x
if (source.walls[index]) tiles.setWallAt(tiles.getTileLocation(x, y), true)
}
}
if (source.objects && currentProgress) {
for (let i = 0; i < source.objects.length; i++) {
let object = source.objects[i]
if (object.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Barrier) continue
if (!validArea(object.arg) || currentProgress.unlocked[object.arg]) continue
let bx = Math.floor(object.x / TILE_SIZE)
let by = Math.floor(object.y / TILE_SIZE)
if (bx >= 0 && bx < source.width && by >= 0 && by < source.height) {
tiles.setWallAt(tiles.getTileLocation(bx, by), true)
}
}
}
}

function objectArtKey(object: farmTypes.WorldObject): string {
if (!object) return ""
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Barrier) {
return currentProgress && object.arg >= 1 && object.arg <= 12 && currentProgress.unlocked[object.arg]
? "object.barrier.open" : "object.barrier.closed"
}
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Travel) return "object.travel"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.SellBox) return "object.sellbox"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Shop) return "object.shop"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Armory) return "object.armory"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Ready) return "object.ready"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.DefenderSlot) return "object.defenderslot"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Spring) return "object.spring"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.PracticePad) return "object.practicepad"
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Reset) return "object.reset"
// Exit is a corridor handoff. TaskStation and Harvest are rendered by
// Package 02's domain state rather than duplicated here.
return ""
}

function renderWorldObjects(source: farmTypes.Layout): void {
clearWorldObjectSprites()
for (let i = 0; i < source.objects.length; i++) {
let object = source.objects[i]
let key = objectArtKey(object)
if (!key) continue
// Locked travel destinations are dormant; the authored floor/rune
// location remains but no active travel sprite is shown yet.
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Travel && currentProgress && object.arg >= 1 && object.arg <= 12 && !currentProgress.unlocked[object.arg]) continue
let sprite = sprites.create(farmArt.frame(key, 0), WORLD_OBJECT_KIND)
sprite.setPosition(object.x, object.y)
worldObjectSprites.push(sprite)
}
}

function setPlayerMovement(enabled: boolean): void {
if (!currentPlayer) return
let speed = enabled ? STARTING_MOVE_SPEED : 0
controller.moveSprite(currentPlayer, speed, speed)
if (!enabled) {
currentPlayer.vx = 0
currentPlayer.vy = 0
}
}

function showNotice(message: string, duration: number): void {
noticeText = message ? message : ""
if (!noticeText) {
noticeUntil = 0
return
}
noticeUntil = control.millis() + duration
}

function resetMenuState(): void {
menuOpen = false
menuTitle = ""
menuOptions = []
menuIndex = 0
menuTop = 0
menuCallback = null
menuDetails = []
quantityMenu = false
quantityValue = 1
quantityMax = 1
quantityUnitValue = 0
quantityCallback = null
}

function menuVisibleRows(): number {
if (quantityMenu) return 0
let detailRows = menuDetails ? menuDetails.length : 0
let rows = MENU_VISIBLE_ROWS - detailRows
if (rows < 2) rows = 2
return rows
}

function openMenu(title: string, options: string[], details: string[], onChoice: (choice: number) => void): boolean {
if (!started || resetPendingRestart || menuOpen || !options || options.length <= 0 || !onChoice) return false
menuTitle = title ? title : "CHOOSE"
menuOptions = []
for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) menuOptions.push(options[i])
menuDetails = []
if (details) for (let i = 0; i < details.length; i++) menuDetails.push(details[i])
menuIndex = 0
menuTop = 0
menuCallback = onChoice
quantityMenu = false
quantityCallback = null
menuOpen = true
setPlayerMovement(false)
return true
}

function closeMenu(choice: number): void {
if (!menuOpen) return
let callback = quantityMenu ? null : menuCallback
let numberCallback = quantityMenu ? quantityCallback : null
resetMenuState()
if (!resetPendingRestart) setPlayerMovement(true)
// Clear state before callback so the callback may immediately request a
// second selector without fighting the old menu's controller ownership.
if (numberCallback) numberCallback(choice)
else if (callback) callback(choice)
}

function moveMenu(delta: number): void {
if (!menuOpen || quantityMenu || menuOptions.length <= 0 || delta == 0) return
let next = menuIndex + delta
if (next < 0) next = 0
if (next >= menuOptions.length) next = menuOptions.length - 1
if (next == menuIndex) return
menuIndex = next
let visible = menuVisibleRows()
if (menuIndex < menuTop) menuTop = menuIndex
if (menuIndex >= menuTop + visible) menuTop = menuIndex - visible + 1
}

function openQuantity(title: string, maxValue: number, unitValue: number, onChoice: (choice: number) => void): boolean {
if (!started || resetPendingRestart || menuOpen || maxValue < 1 || !onChoice) return false
menuTitle = title ? title : "QUANTITY"
menuOptions = []
menuDetails = []
menuCallback = null
quantityMenu = true
quantityValue = 1
quantityMax = maxValue
quantityUnitValue = unitValue
quantityCallback = onChoice
menuOpen = true
setPlayerMovement(false)
return true
}

function changeQuantity(delta: number): void {
if (!menuOpen || !quantityMenu || delta == 0) return
let next = quantityValue + delta
if (next < 1) next = 1
if (next > quantityMax) next = quantityMax
quantityValue = next
}

function wrapLine(text: string, width: number): string[] {
let result: string[] = []
if (!text) return result
let rest = text
while (rest.length > width) {
let cut = width
while (cut > 8 && rest.charAt(cut) != " ") cut--
if (cut <= 8) cut = width
result.push(rest.substr(0, cut))
rest = rest.substr(cut)
while (rest.length > 0 && rest.charAt(0) == " ") rest = rest.substr(1)
}
if (rest.length > 0) result.push(rest)
return result
}

function interactiveObject(object: farmTypes.WorldObject): boolean {
if (!object || object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit) return false
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Travel) {
if (!currentProgress || !validDestination(object.arg)) return false
if (object.arg != 0 && !currentProgress.unlocked[object.arg]) return false
}
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Barrier) {
if (!currentProgress || !validArea(object.arg) || currentProgress.unlocked[object.arg]) return false
}
return true
}

function nearestFacingInteraction(): farmTypes.WorldObject {
if (!currentLayout || !currentPlayer || menuOpen) return null
let best: farmTypes.WorldObject = null
let bestDistance2 = INTERACTION_RANGE2 + 1
for (let i = 0; i < currentLayout.objects.length; i++) {
let object = currentLayout.objects[i]
if (!interactiveObject(object)) continue
let dx = object.x - currentPlayer.x
let dy = object.y - currentPlayer.y
let distance2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
if (distance2 > INTERACTION_RANGE2 || distance2 >= bestDistance2) continue
// Overlap is always eligible. Otherwise the object center must be in
// the player's current half-plane, not merely nearby behind them.
if (distance2 > 4) {
let forward = dx * facingX + dy * facingY
if (forward <= 0) continue
}
best = object
bestDistance2 = distance2
}
return best
}

function canPersistMutation(): boolean {
return !saveBlocked && !farmSave.blocked() && !resetPendingRestart
}

function hasActiveRaid(): boolean {
return hasRaidPhase(currentProgress)
}

function hubPurchaseAvailable(): boolean {
return !!currentProgress && currentProgress.area == 0 && !hasActiveRaid() && canPersistMutation()
}

function refreshCurrentWorldObjects(): void {
if (!currentLayout) return
renderGround(currentLayout)
renderWorldObjects(currentLayout)
}

function areaPrerequisiteMet(area: number): boolean {
if (area <= 1) return true
return !!currentProgress && currentProgress.cleared[area - 1] == 1
}

function purchaseArea(area: number): void {
if (!currentProgress || !validArea(area) || currentProgress.unlocked[area]) return
if (!canPersistMutation()) { notice("SAVE RECOVERY REQUIRED"); return }
if (!areaPrerequisiteMet(area)) { notice("CLEAR " + areaName(area - 1) + " FIRST"); return }
let cost = areaUnlockCost(area)
if (currentProgress.gold < cost) { notice("NEED " + cost + " GOLD"); return }
currentProgress.gold -= cost
currentProgress.unlocked[area] = 1
currentProgress.phase[area] = farmTypes.Phase.Farm
refreshCurrentWorldObjects()
checkpoint("area-purchase")
notice(areaName(area) + " OPEN")
}

function openBarrier(object: farmTypes.WorldObject): void {
if (!object || !validArea(object.arg) || currentProgress.unlocked[object.arg]) return
let area = object.arg
if (!areaPrerequisiteMet(area)) { notice("CLEAR " + areaName(area - 1) + " FIRST"); return }
let cost = areaUnlockCost(area)
let details = ["COST " + cost + "G", "OPENS PATH + TRAVEL RUNE"]
openMenu("UNLOCK " + areaName(area), ["UNLOCK", "BACK"], details, function (choice: number) {
if (choice == 0) purchaseArea(area)
})
}

function travelTo(object: farmTypes.WorldObject): void {
if (!object || !currentProgress || !validDestination(object.arg)) return
let destination = object.arg
if (destination != 0 && !currentProgress.unlocked[destination]) { notice("DESTINATION LOCKED"); return }
requestRegionTransition(destination, object.arg2, "travel")
}

function sellCrop(crop: number, quantity: number): void {
if (!currentProgress || !validCrop(crop) || quantity < 1 || quantity != Math.floor(quantity)) return
if (!canPersistMutation()) { notice("SAVE RECOVERY REQUIRED"); return }
if (currentProgress.inventory[crop] < quantity) { notice("NOT ENOUGH " + cropName(crop)); return }
let value = cropSellValue(crop)
currentProgress.inventory[crop] -= quantity
currentProgress.gold += quantity * value
checkpoint("sell")
notice("SOLD " + quantity + " " + cropName(crop) + "  +" + (quantity * value) + "G")
}

function openSellBox(): void {
if (!currentProgress) return
let crops: number[] = []
let options: string[] = []
for (let crop = 1; crop <= 12; crop++) {
let count = currentProgress.inventory[crop]
if (count <= 0) continue
crops.push(crop)
options.push(cropName(crop) + " x" + count + "  " + cropSellValue(crop) + "G")
}
if (options.length == 0) { notice("NOTHING TO SELL"); return }
openMenu("SELL BOX", options, null, function (choice: number) {
if (choice < 0 || choice >= crops.length) return
let crop = crops[choice]
let owned = currentProgress.inventory[crop]
let value = cropSellValue(crop)
openQuantity("SELL " + cropName(crop), owned, value, function (quantity: number) {
if (quantity > 0) sellCrop(crop, quantity)
})
})
}

function expansionEligible(area: number): boolean {
if (!currentProgress || !validArea(area)) return false
if (!currentProgress.cleared[area]) return false
if (area == 12 && !currentProgress.complete) return false
return currentProgress.expansion[area] < EXPANSION_MAX_TIER[area]
}

function expansionLabel(area: number, nextTier: number): string {
if (nextTier == 2) return EXPANSION_LABEL_TIER2[area]
return EXPANSION_LABEL_TIER1[area]
}

function expansionEffect(area: number, nextTier: number): string {
if (area == 1) return nextTier == 1 ? "Production 6 -> 8; plant/water reporters update." : "Production 8 -> 10; same learner code reuses reporters."
if (area == 9) return "+4 production plots; tutorial beds stay unchanged."
return "+2 production slots; no new required lesson."
}

function buyExpansion(area: number): void {
if (!hubPurchaseAvailable()) { notice("SHOP UNAVAILABLE"); return }
if (!expansionEligible(area)) { notice("EXPANSION NOT AVAILABLE"); return }
let nextTier = currentProgress.expansion[area] + 1
let price = expansionPrice(area, nextTier)
if (price <= 0 || currentProgress.gold < price) { notice("NEED " + price + " GOLD"); return }
currentProgress.gold -= price
currentProgress.expansion[area] = nextTier
checkpoint("production-expansion")
notice(expansionLabel(area, nextTier) + " PURCHASED")
}

function openExpansionDetail(area: number): void {
if (!validArea(area) || !currentProgress) return
let currentTier = currentProgress.expansion[area]
let nextTier = currentTier + 1
if (currentTier >= EXPANSION_MAX_TIER[area]) { notice(areaName(area) + " EXPANSION MAXED"); return }
let price = expansionPrice(area, nextTier)
let details: string[] = [
"CURRENT PRODUCTION " + expansionProduction(area, currentTier),
"NEXT PRODUCTION " + expansionProduction(area, nextTier),
"COST " + price + "G"
]
let wrapped = wrapLine(expansionEffect(area, nextTier), 48)
for (let i = 0; i < wrapped.length; i++) details.push(wrapped[i])
openMenu(expansionLabel(area, nextTier), ["BUY", "BACK"], details, function (choice: number) {
if (choice == 0) buyExpansion(area)
})
}

function openExpansionShop(): void {
if (!hubPurchaseAvailable()) { notice("SHOP UNAVAILABLE"); return }
let areas: number[] = []
let options: string[] = []
for (let area = 1; area <= 12; area++) {
if (!currentProgress.cleared[area]) continue
if (area == 12 && !currentProgress.complete) continue
let tier = currentProgress.expansion[area]
areas.push(area)
if (tier >= EXPANSION_MAX_TIER[area]) options.push(areaName(area) + "  MAXED")
else options.push(expansionLabel(area, tier + 1) + "  " + expansionPrice(area, tier + 1) + "G")
}
if (options.length == 0) { notice("NO EXPANSIONS READY"); return }
openMenu("PRODUCTION EXPANSIONS", options, null, function (choice: number) {
if (choice < 0 || choice >= areas.length) return
openExpansionDetail(areas[choice])
})
}

function upgradeCropEligible(crop: number): boolean {
if (!currentProgress || !validCrop(crop)) return false
if (!currentProgress.cleared[crop] || !currentProgress.powerEarned[crop]) return false
if (crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom && !currentProgress.complete) return false
return true
}

function upgradeIdsForCrop(crop: number): number[] {
let ids: number[] = []
for (let id = 1; id <= 14; id++) if (farmTuning.crop(id) == crop) ids.push(id)
return ids
}

function nestedOutputLine(id: number, level: number): string {
if (!currentProgress) return ""
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps || id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap) {
let caps = farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps, id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps ? level : currentProgress.upgrades[farmTypes.Upgrade.Caps])
let spores = farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap, id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap ? level : currentProgress.upgrades[farmTypes.Upgrade.SporesPerCap])
return "FULL OUTPUT " + (caps * spores) + " SPORES"
}
if (id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Bulbs || id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SparksPerBulb) {
let bulbs = farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.Bulbs, id == farmTypes.Upgrade.Bulbs ? level : currentProgress.upgrades[farmTypes.Upgrade.Bulbs])
let sparks = farmTuning.value(farmTypes.Upgrade.SparksPerBulb, id == farmTypes.Upgrade.SparksPerBulb ? level : currentProgress.upgrades[farmTypes.Upgrade.SparksPerBulb])
return "FULL OUTPUT " + (bulbs * sparks) + " SPARKS"
}
return ""
}

function buyUpgrade(id: number): void {
if (!hubPurchaseAvailable() || id < 1 || id > 14) { notice("UPGRADE UNAVAILABLE"); return }
let crop = farmTuning.crop(id)
if (!upgradeCropEligible(crop) || currentProgress.upgrades[id] >= 1) { notice("UPGRADE NOT AVAILABLE"); return }
let price = farmTuning.price(id)
if (currentProgress.gold < price) { notice("NEED " + price + " GOLD"); return }
currentProgress.gold -= price
currentProgress.upgrades[id] = 1
checkpoint("plant-upgrade")
notice(farmTuning.label(id) + " UPGRADED")
}

function openUpgradeDetail(id: number): void {
if (!currentProgress || id < 1 || id > 14) return
let crop = farmTuning.crop(id)
if (!upgradeCropEligible(crop)) { notice("UPGRADE NOT AVAILABLE"); return }
let level = currentProgress.upgrades[id]
let current = farmTuning.value(id, level)
let details: string[] = []
if (level >= 1) details.push("CURRENT " + current + "  MAXED")
else {
details.push("CURRENT " + current + "  ->  " + farmTuning.value(id, 1))
details.push("COST " + farmTuning.price(id) + "G")
}
let output = nestedOutputLine(id, level >= 1 ? level : 1)
if (output) details.push(output)
let wrapped = wrapLine(farmTuning.effect(id), 48)
for (let i = 0; i < wrapped.length; i++) details.push(wrapped[i])
let options = level >= 1 ? ["MAXED - BACK"] : ["BUY", "BACK"]
openMenu(farmTuning.label(id), options, details, function (choice: number) {
if (level < 1 && choice == 0) buyUpgrade(id)
})
}

function openUpgradeCrop(crop: number): void {
let ids = upgradeIdsForCrop(crop)
if (ids.length == 0) { notice("NO UPGRADES"); return }
if (ids.length == 1) { openUpgradeDetail(ids[0]); return }
let options: string[] = []
for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
let id = ids[i]
let level = currentProgress.upgrades[id]
let current = farmTuning.value(id, level)
options.push(farmTuning.label(id) + "  " + current + (level ? " MAX" : " -> " + farmTuning.value(id, 1)))
}
openMenu(cropName(crop) + " UPGRADES", options, null, function (choice: number) {
if (choice >= 0 && choice < ids.length) openUpgradeDetail(ids[choice])
})
}

function openPlantUpgradeShop(): void {
if (!hubPurchaseAvailable()) { notice("SHOP UNAVAILABLE"); return }
let crops: number[] = []
let options: string[] = []
for (let crop = 1; crop <= 12; crop++) {
if (!upgradeCropEligible(crop)) continue
crops.push(crop)
let ids = upgradeIdsForCrop(crop)
let maxed = true
for (let j = 0; j < ids.length; j++) if (currentProgress.upgrades[ids[j]] == 0) maxed = false
options.push(cropName(crop) + (maxed ? "  MAXED" : ""))
}
if (options.length == 0) { notice("NO PLANT UPGRADES READY"); return }
openMenu("PLANT UPGRADES", options, null, function (choice: number) {
if (choice >= 0 && choice < crops.length) openUpgradeCrop(crops[choice])
})
}

function openShop(): void {
if (!hubPurchaseAvailable()) { notice("SHOP UNAVAILABLE"); return }
openMenu("HUB SHOP", ["PRODUCTION EXPANSIONS", "PLANT UPGRADES"], null, function (choice: number) {
if (choice == 0) openExpansionShop()
else if (choice == 1) openPlantUpgradeShop()
})
}

function armoryOption(weapon: number): string {
if (!currentProgress || !validWeapon(weapon)) return ""
if (currentProgress.weapon == weapon) return WEAPON_NAME[weapon] + "  EQUIPPED"
if (currentProgress.weapons[weapon]) return WEAPON_NAME[weapon] + "  OWNED"
return WEAPON_NAME[weapon] + "  " + weaponPrice(weapon) + "G"
}

function chooseWeapon(weapon: number): void {
if (!hubPurchaseAvailable() || !validWeapon(weapon)) { notice("ARMORY UNAVAILABLE"); return }
if (!currentProgress.weapons[weapon]) {
let price = weaponPrice(weapon)
if (currentProgress.gold < price) { notice("NEED " + price + " GOLD"); return }
currentProgress.gold -= price
currentProgress.weapons[weapon] = 1
}
currentProgress.weapon = weapon
checkpoint("weapon")
notice(WEAPON_NAME[weapon] + " EQUIPPED")
}

function openArmory(): void {
if (!hubPurchaseAvailable()) { notice("ARMORY UNAVAILABLE"); return }
let options: string[] = []
for (let weapon = 0; weapon <= 2; weapon++) options.push(armoryOption(weapon))
openMenu("ARMORY", options, null, function (choice: number) {
if (choice >= 0 && choice <= 2) chooseWeapon(choice)
})
}

function finishReset(): void {
farmSave.reset()
saveBlocked = true
resetPendingRestart = true
noticeText = ""
noticeUntil = 0
setPlayerMovement(false)
}

function openResetFlow(): void {
openMenu("RECOVERY ONLY", ["BACK", "OPEN RESET"], ["Reset is never needed for normal progression."], function (choice: number) {
if (choice != 1) return
openMenu("DELETE FARM SAVE?", ["CANCEL", "CONTINUE"], ["This removes Magical Farm save data only."], function (choice2: number) {
if (choice2 != 1) return
openMenu("FINAL CONFIRMATION", ["NO - KEEP FARM", "YES - DELETE"], ["Deletion cannot be undone."], function (choice3: number) {
if (choice3 == 1) finishReset()
})
})
})
}

function beginRaidTransaction(area: number): void {
if (!currentProgress || !validArea(area)) return
if (currentProgress.area != area || currentProgress.phase[area] != farmTypes.Phase.Prep) return
if (!canPersistMutation()) { notice("SAVE RECOVERY REQUIRED"); return }

// Re-check both domains at confirmation time. A menu freezes movement,
// but asynchronous learner work may have resolved since it opened.
let farmReady = farmTasks.ready(area)
let combatReady = farmCombat.ready(area)
if (!farmReady || !combatReady) return

let preProgress = cloneProgress(currentProgress)
let preFarm = farmTasks.exportState()
if (!preFarm) { notice("COULD NOT SAVE RAID SETUP"); return }

raidRecoveryProgress = cloneProgress(preProgress)
raidRecoveryFarm = cloneNumberArray(preFarm)
activeRaidArea = area

// The durable envelope is written *before* Combat begins. Its current
// snapshot records RAID, while recovery records the exact adjustable
// PREP setup. A reload at any point therefore returns to PREP.
currentProgress.phase[area] = farmTypes.Phase.Raid
playerHp = STARTING_HP
let currentFarm = farmTasks.exportState()
if (!currentFarm || !farmSave.write(currentProgress, currentFarm, raidRecoveryProgress, raidRecoveryFarm)) {
currentProgress = preProgress
farmTasks.importState(preFarm)
clearRaidRecovery()
notice("COULD NOT SAVE RAID SETUP")
return
}

if (!farmCombat.beginRaid(area)) {
// Combat declined after the durable checkpoint. Restore the same
// PREP snapshot and immediately commit a stable non-RAID save.
currentProgress = preProgress
farmTasks.importState(preFarm)
clearRaidRecovery()
checkpoint("raid-begin-rejected")
notice("RAID COULD NOT START")
return
}
notice("RAID START")
}

function requestReady(object: farmTypes.WorldObject): void {
if (!object || !currentProgress || hasActiveRaid()) return
let area = currentProgress.area
if (!validArea(area) || object.arg != area) return
if (currentProgress.phase[area] != farmTypes.Phase.Prep) {
notice(currentProgress.phase[area] == farmTypes.Phase.Production ? "AREA ALREADY CLEARED" : "FINISH FARM WORK FIRST")
return
}

// Both domains get to report their own specific missing requirement.
// World opens the start confirmation only when both agree.
let farmReady = farmTasks.ready(area)
let combatReady = farmCombat.ready(area)
if (!farmReady || !combatReady) return

openMenu("READY - " + areaName(area), ["BEGIN RAID", "BACK"], ["Failure restores this exact setup."], function (choice: number) {
if (choice == 0) beginRaidTransaction(area)
})
}

function programBusy(): boolean {
// Program owns exact execution slots. World checks every farm task and
// defender species so a cancelled callback is never replaced by a new
// scene while it still occupies its real slot.
for (let task = farmTypes.Task.Plant; task <= farmTypes.Task.Grove; task++) {
if (farmProgram.busy(task)) return true
}
for (let task = farmTypes.Task.SixShooter; task <= farmTypes.Task.Stormbloom; task++) {
if (farmProgram.busy(task)) return true
}
return false
}

function transitionPending(): boolean {
return pendingTransitionArea >= 0
}

function clearPendingTransition(): void {
pendingTransitionArea = -1
pendingTransitionEntryObjectId = -1
pendingTransitionReason = ""
pendingTransitionStartedMs = 0
pendingTransitionRecoveryShown = false
}

function finishPendingTransition(): boolean {
if (!transitionPending()) return false
if (programBusy()) {
setPlayerMovement(false)
if (!pendingTransitionRecoveryShown
&& control.millis() - pendingTransitionStartedMs >= 2000) {
pendingTransitionRecoveryShown = true
showNotice("CODE STILL RUNNING - STOP / EDIT / RESTART IF NEEDED", TRANSITION_RECOVERY_NOTICE_MS)
}
return false
}

let area = pendingTransitionArea
let entryObjectId = pendingTransitionEntryObjectId
let reason = pendingTransitionReason
clearPendingTransition()

if (!loadRegion(area, entryObjectId)) {
setPlayerMovement(!menuOpen)
notice("PATH UNAVAILABLE")
return false
}
checkpoint(reason)
return true
}

function requestRegionTransition(area: number, entryObjectId: number, reason: string): boolean {
if (!currentProgress || !layoutAreaValid(area) || transitionPending()) return false
if (resetPendingRestart || saveBlocked || farmSave.blocked() || menuOpen) return false
if (hasActiveRaid()) {
notice("FINISH THE RAID FIRST")
return false
}
if (area != 0 && !currentProgress.unlocked[area]) return false

pendingTransitionArea = area
pendingTransitionEntryObjectId = entryObjectId
pendingTransitionReason = reason ? reason : "region-transition"
pendingTransitionStartedMs = control.millis()
pendingTransitionRecoveryShown = false

// Cancellation is cooperative. It invalidates contexts immediately, but
// ENGINEERING_LIMITS explicitly forbids pretending it kills an arbitrary
// currently executing learner loop. Movement freezes until all slots
// report actual callback return.
farmProgram.cancelAll()
setPlayerMovement(false)
if (programBusy()) {
showNotice("WAITING FOR CURRENT CODE TO RETURN", NOTICE_MS)
return true
}
finishPendingTransition()
return true
}

function maybeTriggerExit(): void {
if (!currentLayout || !currentPlayer || !currentProgress) return
if (menuOpen || resetPendingRestart || saveBlocked || hasActiveRaid() || transitionPending()) return
for (let i = 0; i < currentLayout.objects.length; i++) {
let object = currentLayout.objects[i]
if (!object || object.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit) continue
if (!validDestination(object.arg)) continue
if (object.arg != 0 && !currentProgress.unlocked[object.arg]) continue
let dx = object.x - currentPlayer.x
let dy = object.y - currentPlayer.y
if (dx * dx + dy * dy > EXIT_TRIGGER_RANGE2) continue
requestRegionTransition(object.arg, object.arg2, "exit")
return
}
}

function periodicCheckpoint(): void {
if (!currentProgress || saveBlocked || farmSave.blocked() || resetPendingRestart) return
if (programBusy()) return
if (currentProgress.playedMs - lastPeriodicCheckpointClock < SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS) return
checkpoint("elapsed-progress")
}

function updateWorld(): void {
if (!started || !currentProgress) return
updateFacing()

let now = control.millis()
if (lastUpdateMs <= 0) {
lastUpdateMs = now
return
}
let elapsed = now - lastUpdateMs
lastUpdateMs = now
if (elapsed < 0) elapsed = 0

if (!resetPendingRestart && !saveBlocked && !farmSave.blocked()) {
// playedMs and productionTick receive actual active-runtime elapsed
// time. Domain simulation receives a bounded frame delta exactly as
// MF-CONTRACT-1.0 specifies, so a delayed frame cannot inject a huge
// AI/animation step.
currentProgress.playedMs += elapsed
if (elapsed > 0) farmTasks.productionTick(elapsed)

let dt = elapsed
if (dt < 0) dt = 0
if (dt > MAX_UPDATE_DT_MS) dt = MAX_UPDATE_DT_MS
farmTasks.update(dt)
farmCombat.update(dt)
}

if (transitionPending()) {
finishPendingTransition()
} else {
maybeTriggerExit()
}
periodicCheckpoint()
}

function dispatchInteraction(object: farmTypes.WorldObject): void {
if (!object || resetPendingRestart) return
if (saveBlocked && object.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Reset) { notice("SAVE RECOVERY REQUIRED"); return }
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.TaskStation || object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Harvest || object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Spring) {
farmTasks.interact(object)
return
}
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.DefenderSlot || object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.PracticePad) {
farmCombat.interact(object)
return
}
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Barrier) { openBarrier(object); return }
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Travel) { travelTo(object); return }
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.SellBox) { openSellBox(); return }
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Shop) { openShop(); return }
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Armory) { openArmory(); return }
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Ready) { requestReady(object); return }
if (object.kind == farmTypes.ObjectKind.Reset) { openResetFlow(); return }
}

function updateFacing(): void {
if (!currentPlayer || menuOpen) return
let vx = currentPlayer.vx
let vy = currentPlayer.vy
if (Math.abs(vx) < 1 && Math.abs(vy) < 1) return
if (Math.abs(vx) >= Math.abs(vy)) {
facingX = vx < 0 ? -1 : 1
facingY = 0
} else {
facingX = 0
facingY = vy < 0 ? -1 : 1
}
}

function drawHud(): void {
if (!started || !currentProgress) return
// Sparse persistent HUD only: HP and gold. World-local resources remain
// on their objects/plants and are never promoted to global meters.
screen.fillRect(6, 6, 86, 20, 1)
screen.print("HP " + playerHp, 12, 12, 15, image.font8)
screen.fillRect(VIEWPORT_WIDTH - 124, 6, 118, 20, 1)
screen.print("GOLD " + currentProgress.gold, VIEWPORT_WIDTH - 116, 12, 15, image.font8)
}

function drawNotice(): void {
if (!noticeText) return
if (control.millis() >= noticeUntil) {
noticeText = ""
noticeUntil = 0
return
}
screen.fillRect(60, VIEWPORT_HEIGHT - 46, VIEWPORT_WIDTH - 120, 28, 1)
screen.printCenter(noticeText, VIEWPORT_HEIGHT - 38, 15, image.font8)
}

function drawMenu(): void {
if (!menuOpen) return
screen.fillRect(MENU_X, MENU_Y, MENU_WIDTH, MENU_HEIGHT, 1)
screen.fillRect(MENU_X + 4, MENU_Y + 4, MENU_WIDTH - 8, MENU_HEIGHT - 8, 15)
screen.fillRect(MENU_X + 8, MENU_Y + 8, MENU_WIDTH - 16, MENU_HEIGHT - 16, 13)
screen.printCenter(menuTitle, MENU_Y + 22, 15, image.font8)

if (quantityMenu) {
screen.printCenter("QUANTITY " + quantityValue + " / " + quantityMax, MENU_Y + 104, 15, image.font8)
screen.printCenter("TOTAL " + (quantityValue * quantityUnitValue) + "G", MENU_Y + 142, 15, image.font8)
screen.printCenter("LEFT/RIGHT +/-1    UP/DOWN +/-10", MENU_Y + 206, 15, image.font8)
screen.printCenter("A: SELL    B: BACK", MENU_Y + MENU_HEIGHT - 26, 15, image.font8)
return
}

let detailY = MENU_Y + 48
for (let i = 0; i < menuDetails.length; i++) {
screen.print(menuDetails[i], MENU_X + 28, detailY + i * 18, 15, image.font8)
}
let firstY = MENU_Y + 54 + menuDetails.length * 18
let visible = menuVisibleRows()
let end = menuTop + visible
if (end > menuOptions.length) end = menuOptions.length
for (let i = menuTop; i < end; i++) {
let row = i - menuTop
let y = firstY + row * MENU_ROW_HEIGHT
if (i == menuIndex) {
screen.fillRect(MENU_X + 18, y - 5, MENU_WIDTH - 36, MENU_ROW_HEIGHT - 2, 5)
screen.print("> " + menuOptions[i], MENU_X + 28, y, 15, image.font8)
} else {
screen.print("  " + menuOptions[i], MENU_X + 28, y, 15, image.font8)
}
}
if (menuTop > 0) screen.print("^ MORE", MENU_X + MENU_WIDTH - 82, MENU_Y + 40, 15, image.font8)
if (end < menuOptions.length) screen.print("v MORE", MENU_X + MENU_WIDTH - 82, MENU_Y + MENU_HEIGHT - 50, 15, image.font8)
screen.printCenter("A: SELECT    B: BACK", MENU_Y + MENU_HEIGHT - 26, 15, image.font8)
}

function drawResetTerminal(): void {
if (!resetPendingRestart) return
screen.fillRect(80, 150, VIEWPORT_WIDTH - 160, 160, 1)
screen.fillRect(86, 156, VIEWPORT_WIDTH - 172, 148, 15)
screen.printCenter("MAGICAL FARM SAVE DELETED", 194, 1, image.font8)
screen.printCenter("RESTART THE SIMULATOR TO BEGIN FRESH", 232, 1, image.font8)
screen.printCenter("NO SAVE WILL BE WRITTEN UNTIL RESTART", 270, 1, image.font8)
}

function drawWorldUi(): void {
drawHud()
drawNotice()
drawMenu()
drawResetTerminal()
}

function onAPressed(): void {
if (!started || resetPendingRestart) return
if (menuOpen) {
closeMenu(quantityMenu ? quantityValue : menuIndex)
return
}
dispatchInteraction(nearestFacingInteraction())
}

function onBPressed(): void {
if (!started || resetPendingRestart) return
if (menuOpen) {
closeMenu(-1)
return
}
if (!saveBlocked) farmCombat.attack()
}

function installUiAndControls(): void {
if (uiInstalled) return
uiInstalled = true
controller.A.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, onAPressed)
controller.B.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, onBPressed)
controller.up.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () { if (menuOpen) { if (quantityMenu) changeQuantity(10); else moveMenu(-1) } })
controller.left.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () { if (menuOpen) { if (quantityMenu) changeQuantity(-1); else moveMenu(-1) } })
controller.down.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () { if (menuOpen) { if (quantityMenu) changeQuantity(-10); else moveMenu(1) } })
controller.right.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () { if (menuOpen) { if (quantityMenu) changeQuantity(1); else moveMenu(1) } })
game.onUpdate(updateWorld)
// UI must draw after the authored tilemap and sprites.
game.onShade(drawWorldUi)
}

function inwardEntryPoint(source: farmTypes.Layout, objectId: number): farmTypes.Point {
let result = new farmTypes.Point()
result.x = source.entry.x
result.y = source.entry.y
if (objectId < 0) return result
for (let i = 0; i < source.objects.length; i++) {
let object = source.objects[i]
if (object.kind != farmTypes.ObjectKind.Exit || object.id != objectId) continue
result.x = object.x
result.y = object.y
let centerX = source.width * TILE_SIZE / 2
let centerY = source.height * TILE_SIZE / 2
if (object.x < centerX) result.x += TILE_SIZE
else if (object.x > centerX) result.x -= TILE_SIZE
if (object.y < centerY) result.y += TILE_SIZE
else if (object.y > centerY) result.y -= TILE_SIZE
return result
}
return result
}

function ensurePlayer(position: farmTypes.Point): void {
if (!currentPlayer) currentPlayer = sprites.create(farmArt.frame("player.walk.down", 0), PLAYER_KIND)
else currentPlayer.setImage(farmArt.frame("player.walk.down", 0))
currentPlayer.setPosition(position.x, position.y)
scene.cameraFollowSprite(currentPlayer)
setPlayerMovement(!menuOpen)
}

function loadRegion(area: number, entryObjectId: number): boolean {
if (!layoutAreaValid(area)) return false
let next = farmLayout.get(area)
if (!validLayout(next, area)) return false

clearRegion()
currentLayout = next
renderGround(next)
renderWorldObjects(next)
ensurePlayer(inwardEntryPoint(next, entryObjectId))
currentProgress.area = area
farmTasks.enter(area)
farmCombat.enter(area)
return true
}

function finishStartup(): void {
if (!currentProgress) currentProgress = freshProgress()
let area = currentProgress.area
if (!layoutAreaValid(area)) area = 1
if (!loadRegion(area, -1) && area != 1) loadRegion(1, -1)
lastUpdateMs = control.millis()
lastPeriodicCheckpointClock = currentProgress.playedMs
clearPendingTransition()
if (saveRecoveryMessage) showNotice(saveRecoveryMessage, RECOVERY_NOTICE_MS)
}

export function start(): void {
if (started) return
started = true
installUiAndControls()
playerHp = STARTING_HP
let loaded = farmSave.load()
saveBlocked = loaded.status == farmSave.LoadStatus.Corrupt || loaded.status == farmSave.LoadStatus.Future
if (saveBlocked) {
currentProgress = freshProgress()
saveRecoveryMessage = loaded.status == farmSave.LoadStatus.Future
? "SAVE FROM NEWER VERSION - RECOVERY REQUIRED"
: "SAVE DAMAGED - RECOVERY REQUIRED"
finishStartup()
return
}

if (loaded.primary) {
let primaryRecoveredRaid = candidateNeedsRaidRecovery(loaded.primary)
if (tryLoadSnapshot(candidateSnapshot(loaded.primary))) {
finishStartup()
// Normalize an interrupted RAID into a newer stable PREP save
// after both World and Farming recovery data have validated.
if (primaryRecoveredRaid) checkpoint("interrupted-raid-recovery")
return
}
let alternateRecoveredRaid = candidateNeedsRaidRecovery(loaded.alternate)
if (loaded.alternate && tryLoadSnapshot(candidateSnapshot(loaded.alternate))) {
finishStartup()
if (alternateRecoveredRaid) checkpoint("interrupted-raid-recovery")
return
}
// Envelope(s) were complete but Package 02 rejected every farm
// payload. Preserve the original settings keys and block writes.
currentProgress = freshProgress()
saveBlocked = true
saveRecoveryMessage = "FARM SAVE INVALID - RECOVERY REQUIRED"
finishStartup()
return
}

currentProgress = freshProgress()
finishStartup()
}

export function progress(): farmTypes.Progress {
return cloneProgress(currentProgress)
}

export function player(): Sprite {
return currentPlayer
}

export function layout(): farmTypes.Layout {
return currentLayout
}

export function notice(message: string): void {
showNotice(message, NOTICE_MS)
}

export function taskResult(result: farmTypes.RunResult): void {
if (!ensureProgress() || !result || resetPendingRestart) return
if (!validLearnerTask(result.task)) return
if (!canPersistMutation()) {
notice("SAVE RECOVERY REQUIRED")
return
}

let farmArea = farmTaskArea(result.task)
if (farmArea > 0) {
// Farm-earned capability is only a completed Farm-mode invocation
// for that task's authored area. A late callback from a scene the
// player has left, Regrow work, or a later phase cannot earn it.
if (result.area != farmArea || result.mode != farmTypes.Mode.Farm) return
if (!acceptFreshResultToken(result.task, result.token)) return
if (currentProgress.area != farmArea || currentProgress.phase[farmArea] != farmTypes.Phase.Farm) return
if (result.code != farmTypes.ResultCode.Success) {
resultFeedback(result)
return
}
if (currentProgress.farmEarned[result.task]) return

currentProgress.farmEarned[result.task] = 1
if (farmRequirementsEarned(farmArea)) currentProgress.phase[farmArea] = farmTypes.Phase.Prep
checkpoint("farm-capability")
notice(currentProgress.phase[farmArea] == farmTypes.Phase.Prep ? "DEFENSE PREP READY" : "FARM TASK READY")
return
}

let crop = powerCrop(result.task)
if (!validCrop(crop)) return
let practiceArea = powerPracticeArea(crop)
// Required power awards come only from the explicit preview/practice
// invocation in the authored preparation area. Raid execution remains
// current learner code but cannot retroactively award the prerequisite.
if (result.area != practiceArea || result.mode != farmTypes.Mode.Preview) return
if (!acceptFreshResultToken(result.task, result.token)) return
if (currentProgress.area != practiceArea || currentProgress.phase[practiceArea] != farmTypes.Phase.Prep) return
if (result.code != farmTypes.ResultCode.Success) {
resultFeedback(result)
return
}
if (currentProgress.powerEarned[crop]) return

currentProgress.powerEarned[crop] = 1
checkpoint("power-capability")
notice(crop == farmTypes.Crop.Stormbloom ? "STORMBLOOM PRACTICE READY" : cropName(crop) + " POWER READY")
}

export function choose(title: string, options: string[], onChoice: (choice: number) => void): boolean {
return openMenu(title, options, null, onChoice)
}

export function raidFinished(success: boolean): void {
if (!ensureProgress() || activeRaidArea <= 0 || !raidRecoveryProgress) return
let area = activeRaidArea
if (currentProgress.area != area || currentProgress.phase[area] != farmTypes.Phase.Raid) return

if (!success) {
// Import Farming first; only replace World authority if its opaque
// recovery payload validates. This prevents a half-restored state.
let recoveryFarm = cloneNumberArray(raidRecoveryFarm)
if (!farmTasks.importState(recoveryFarm)) {
saveBlocked = true
notice("RAID RECOVERY FAILED - RESTART")
return
}
currentProgress = cloneProgress(raidRecoveryProgress)
playerHp = STARTING_HP
clearRaidRecovery()
checkpoint("raid-failure")
notice("RAID FAILED - SETUP RESTORED")
return
}

// World commits only durable consequences. Combat has already decided
// victory and Farming retains the resulting crop state. Placement records
// become permanently rooted only at this success commit.
for (let i = 0; i < currentProgress.placements.length; i++) {
if (currentProgress.placements[i].area == area) currentProgress.placements[i].rooted = true
}
currentProgress.cleared[area] = 1
currentProgress.phase[area] = farmTypes.Phase.Production
if (area == 12) currentProgress.complete = true
playerHp = STARTING_HP
clearRaidRecovery()
checkpoint("raid-success")
notice(area == 12 ? "MAGICAL FARM COMPLETE" : cropName(area) + " UNLOCKED")
}

// Read-only combat observation. World retains all HP mutation/reset authority.
export function playerHealth(): number {
if (!started || resetPendingRestart) return 0
return playerHp
}

export function changePlayerHp(delta: number): void {
if (!ensureProgress()) return
playerHp += delta
if (playerHp < 0) playerHp = 0
if (playerHp > STARTING_HP) playerHp = STARTING_HP
}

export function addInventory(crop: number, delta: number): boolean {
if (!ensureProgress() || !validCrop(crop)) return false
if (delta != Math.floor(delta)) return false
let before = currentProgress.inventory[crop]
let after = before + delta
if (after < 0) return false
currentProgress.inventory[crop] = after
return true
}

export function putPlacement(placement: farmTypes.Placement): boolean {
if (!ensureProgress() || !placement || hasActiveRaid()) return false
if (!validArea(placement.area) || !validCrop(placement.crop)) return false
if (placement.slot < 0 || placement.slot != Math.floor(placement.slot)) return false
if (findPlacementIndex(placement.area, placement.slot) >= 0) return false
if (currentProgress.inventory[placement.crop] <= 0) return false

// Commit only after every validation has passed. Public placement is a
// staging mutation: exactly one inventory item becomes one slot record.
let stored = clonePlacement(placement)
currentProgress.inventory[placement.crop] -= 1
currentProgress.placements.push(stored)
return true
}

export function removePlacement(area: number, slot: number): boolean {
if (!ensureProgress() || !validArea(area) || hasActiveRaid()) return false
if (slot < 0 || slot != Math.floor(slot)) return false
let index = findPlacementIndex(area, slot)
if (index < 0) return false
let stored = currentProgress.placements[index]
if (stored.rooted) return false

// Removal of a staged defender is also atomic: return stock and then
// remove the record. Rooted defenders are durable history and immutable.
currentProgress.inventory[stored.crop] += 1
currentProgress.placements.removeAt(index)
return true
}

export function checkpoint(reason: string): void {
if (!ensureProgress() || saveBlocked || farmSave.blocked()) return
let farm = farmTasks.exportState()
if (!farm) return
let written = false
if (hasRaidPhase(currentProgress) && raidRecoveryProgress) {
written = farmSave.write(currentProgress, farm, raidRecoveryProgress, raidRecoveryFarm)
} else {
written = farmSave.write(currentProgress, farm)
}
if (written) lastPeriodicCheckpointClock = currentProgress.playedMs
}

export function clock(): number {
if (!currentProgress) return 0
return currentProgress.playedMs
}
}

// SUPPLIED SOURCE: bootstrap.ts
// Supplied startup only. Current learner registrations belong in main.ts.
farmWorld.start()
```
